EMA批准度伐利尤单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇适用于作为系统治疗候选者的原发性晚期或复发性子宫内膜癌成人患者的一线治疗， 对于错配修复正常（pMMR）型子宫内膜癌，使用度伐利尤单抗联合奥拉帕利进行维持治疗。
EMA批准度伐利尤单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇适用于作为系统治疗候选者的原发性晚期或复发性子宫内膜癌成人患者的一线治疗， 对于错配修复缺陷（dMMR）型子宫内膜癌，使用度伐利尤单抗进行单药维持治疗。
FDA批准曲妥珠单抗联合紫杉醇用于HER2过表达转移性乳腺癌患者的一线治疗。
NMPA批准曲妥珠单抗与紫杉醇或多西他赛联合，用于HER2阳性、未接受化疗的转移性乳腺癌患者。
NMPA批准曲妥珠单抗用于HER2阳性的早期乳腺癌：接受了手术、含蒽环类抗生素辅助化疗和放疗（如果适用）后的单药辅助治疗；多柔比星和环磷酰胺化疗后序贯曲妥珠单抗与紫杉醇或多西他赛的联合辅助治疗；与多西他赛和卡铂联合的辅助治疗。
EMA批准曲妥珠单抗联合紫杉醇用于治疗未接受过化疗且不适合使用蒽环类药物的HER2阳性转移性乳腺癌患者。
FDA批准曲妥珠单抗联合多柔比星、环磷酰胺、紫杉醇治疗HER2过表达、淋巴结阳性或阴性(ER/PR阴性或具有高风险特征(肿瘤大于2cm，年龄<35岁，组织学和/或核分级为2或3级等))的乳腺癌患者。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合紫杉醇、顺铂或紫杉醇、拓朴替康用于治疗持续性、复发或转移性宫颈癌。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合紫杉醇、顺铂或紫杉醇、拓朴替康用于治疗持续性、复发或转移性宫颈癌。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合紫杉醇、聚乙二醇多柔比星或拓扑替康用于治疗铂类耐药的之前接受过不超过2种化疗方案的复发性上皮卵巢、输卵管或原发性腹膜癌。
NMPA批准信迪利单抗联合紫杉醇和顺铂或氟尿嘧啶和顺铂用于不可切除的局部晚期、复发或转移性食管鳞癌的一线治疗。
FDA批准雷莫西尤单抗单药或联合紫杉醇用于既往经含氟嘧啶或含铂化疗进展的、局部晚期或转移性胃癌或胃食管交界处腺癌患者的治疗。
NMPA批准雷莫西尤单抗联合紫杉醇用于在含氟尿嘧啶类或含铂类化疗期间或化疗后出现疾病进展的晚期胃或胃食管结合部腺癌的治疗。
NMPA批准特瑞普利单抗联合紫杉醇和顺铂用于不可切除的局部晚期/复发或远处转移性食管鳞癌（ESCC）患者的一线治疗。
EMA批准特瑞普利单抗联合顺铂和紫杉醇用于不可切除的晚期、复发或转移性食管鳞状细胞癌成人患者的一线治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: EMA approved dostarlimab (dostarlimab-gxly) in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel for the first-line treatment of adult patients with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer (EC) who are candidates for systemic therapy.

EMA has approved durvalumab in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel is indicated for the first-line treatment of adults with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer who are candidates for systemic therapy, followed by maintenance treatment with durvalumab in combination with olaparib in endometrial cancer that is mismatch repair proficient (pMMR).

EMA has approved durvalumab in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel is indicated for the first-line treatment of adults with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer who are candidates for systemic therapy, followed by maintenance treatment with durvalumab ias monotherapy in endometrial cancer that is mismatch repair deficient (dMMR).
EMA approved trastuzumab combined with paclitaxel to treat HER2 positive metastatic breast cancer patients who have not received chemotherapy and are not suitable for anthracycline drugs.

EMA approved toripalimab in combination with cisplatin and paclitaxel for the first line treatment of adult patients with unresectable advanced, recurrent, or metastatic oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

drug.drug_mechanism_cn: Pazopanib（帕唑帕尼）是一种多酪氨酸激酶抑制剂，包括血管内皮生长因子受体（VEGFR）-1，VEGFR-2，VEGFR-3，血小板衍生生长因子受体（PDGFR）-α和-β，成纤维细胞生长因子受体（FGFR） -1和-3，细胞因子受体（Kit），白介素2受体诱导的T细胞激酶（Itk），淋巴细胞特异性蛋白酪氨酸激酶（Lck）和跨膜糖蛋白受体酪氨酸激酶（c-Fms）。 在体外，Pazopanib抑制配体诱导的VEGFR-2，Kit和PDGFR-β受体的自磷酸化。 在体内，Pazopanib抑制小鼠肺中VEGF诱导的VEGFR-2磷酸化，小鼠模型中的血管生成以及小鼠中某些人肿瘤异种移植物的生长。

Olaparib（Lynparza）是聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）酶的抑制剂，包括PARP1，PARP2和PARP3。 PARP酶参与正常的细胞功能，例如DNA转录和DNA修复。 已经证明Olaparib在体外抑制人类肿瘤小鼠异种移植模型中特定肿瘤细胞系的生长，无论是单一疗法还是铂类化学疗法。 在细胞株和小鼠肿瘤模型中发现，用olaparib治疗后细胞毒性和抗肿瘤活性增加，而BRCA和非BRCA蛋白的缺陷与DNA损伤的同源重组修复（HRR）有关，并与铂反应相关。 体外研究表明，Olaparib诱导的细胞毒性可能涉及抑制PARP酶活性和增加PARP-DNA复合物的形成，从而导致细胞稳态的破坏和细胞死亡。
adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准奥拉帕利联合贝伐珠单抗用于一线铂类为基础的化疗完全或部分缓解的、HRD阳性的晚期卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成人患者的治疗，其中HRD阳性定义为携带BRCA有害或疑似有害突变或基因组不稳定。
NMPA批准奥拉帕利联合贝伐珠单抗用于同源重组修复缺陷（HRD）阳性的晚期上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成人患者在一线含铂化疗联合贝伐珠单抗治疗达到完全缓解或部分缓解后的维持治疗。
EMA批准奥拉帕利联合贝伐珠单抗用于成年晚期（FIGO III–IV期）高级别上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌患者的维持治疗，患者在完成一线含铂化疗联合贝伐珠单抗后达到治疗反应（完全缓解或部分缓解），且其肿瘤具有HRD阳性状态。HRD阳性定义为符合以下任一条件：BRCA1/2突变阳性；和/或基因组不稳定性（genomic instability）阳性。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带有害或疑似有害BRCA胚系变异（gBRCAm）的前线经3线及以上化疗的晚期卵巢癌成人患者的治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带BRCA胚系突变（gBRCAm）的HER2阴性的转移性乳腺癌成人患者，这些患者既往接受过新辅助、辅助或转移性治疗中接受过化疗；HR阳性的乳腺癌患者应接受过内分泌治疗或被认为不适合进行内分泌治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带胚系或体细胞 BRCA 突变、一线基于铂类化疗完全缓解或部分缓解的晚期上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成人患者的维持治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带有害或疑似有害BRCA胚系突变的（gBRCAm）、接受一线铂类化疗至少16周无进展的转移性胰腺腺癌成人患者的治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带有害或疑似有害的HRR基因胚系或体细胞突变的（ATMm、BRCA1m、BRCA2m、BARD1m、BRIP1m、CDK12m、CHEK1m、CHEK2m、FANCLm、PALB2m、RAD51Bm、 RAD51Cm、RAD51Dm、RAD54Lm）、前线经恩杂鲁胺或阿比特龙治疗的转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌成人患者（mCRPC）的治疗。
NMPA批准奥拉帕利适用于携带胚系或体细胞BRCA突变的（gBRCAm或sBRCAm）晚期上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成人患者在一线含铂化疗达到完全缓解或部分缓解后的维持治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利适用于携带有害或疑似有害胚系变异（gBRCAm）的、HER2阴性、高风险早期乳腺癌成人患者的辅助治疗，这些患者既往接受过新辅助或辅助化疗。
NMPA批准奥拉帕利用于铂敏感的复发性上皮性卵巢癌或输卵管癌、原发性腹膜癌成人患者在含铂化疗达到完全缓解或部分缓解后的维持治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带胚系或体细胞 BRCA 突变、基于铂类化疗完全缓解或部分缓解的晚期上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成人患者的维持治疗。
NMPA附条件批准奥拉帕利单药用于携带胚系或体细胞BRCA突变（gBRCAm或sBRCAm）且既往治疗（包括一种新型内分泌药物）失败的转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌成人患者的治疗。
EMA批准奥拉帕利用于成人晚期（FIGO III期和IV期）BRCA1/2突变（胚系和/或体细胞）高级别上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌患者的维持治疗，且患者在完成一线铂类化疗后达到缓解（完全缓解或部分缓解）。
EMA批准奥拉帕利单药或联合内分泌治疗，用于既往接受过新辅助或辅助化疗的成年患者中，携带胚系BRCA1/2突变（gBRCAm）、HER2阴性的高危早期乳腺癌的辅助治疗。
EMA批准奥拉帕利用于携带胚系BRCA1/2突变（gBRCA1/2）、HER2阴性的局部晚期或转移性乳腺癌成年患者的治疗。患者既往应接受过蒽环类和紫杉烷类药物治疗，治疗可在（新）辅助或转移性疾病阶段进行；如果患者不适合接受上述治疗，则可例外。对于激素受体（HR）阳性乳腺癌患者，还应在既往内分泌治疗期间或治疗后出现疾病进展，或被认为不适合接受内分泌治疗。
EMA批准奥拉帕利用于成人携带胚系BRCA1/2突变、患有转移性胰腺腺癌且在一线化疗方案中接受至少16周含铂治疗后未发生疾病进展患者的维持治疗。
EMA批准奥拉帕利用于既往接受过包含新型激素药物（NHA）治疗且疾病进展的、携带BRCA1/2突变（胚系和/或体细胞）的成人转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌（mCRPC）患者的治疗。
EMA批准度伐利尤单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇适用于作为系统治疗候选者的原发性晚期或复发性子宫内膜癌成人患者的一线治疗， 对于错配修复正常（pMMR）型子宫内膜癌，使用度伐利尤单抗联合奥拉帕利进行维持治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利与阿比特龙和泼尼松（或泼尼松龙）联合用于有害或疑似有害BRCA突变（BRCAm）转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌（mCRPC）成人患者。
FDA批准奥拉帕利与阿比特龙和泼尼松（或泼尼松龙）联合用于有害或疑似有害BRCA突变（BRCAm）转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌（mCRPC）成人患者。
adaptation_disease_en:
FDA approved Olaparib in combination with bevacizumab for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary 
peritoneal cancer who are in complete or partial response to first-line platinum-based chemotherapy and whose cancer is associated with homologous recombination deficiency (HRD)-positive status defined by either: a deleterious or suspected deleterious BRCA mutation, and/or genomic instability.

EMA approved olaparib in combination with bevacizumab for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with advanced (FIGO stages III and IV) high-grade epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who are in response (complete or partial) following completion of first-line platinum-based chemotherapy in combination with bevacizumab and whose tumors are HRD-positive, defined as either BRCA1/2 mutation-positive and/or genomic instability-positive.

FDA approved Olaparib for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline BRCA-mutated (gBRCAm) advanced ovarian cancer who have been treated with three or more prior lines of chemotherapy.

FDA approved Olaparib for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious gBRCAm, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer who have 
been treated with chemotherapy in the neoadjuvant, adjuvant or metastatic setting. Patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive breast cancer should have been treated with a prior endocrine therapy or be considered inappropriate for endocrine therapy.

FDA approved Olaparib for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline or somatic BRCA-mutated advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer who are in complete or partial response to first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.

FDA approved Olaparib for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious gBRCAm metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma whose disease has not progressed on at least 16 weeks of a first-line platinum-based chemotherapy regimen.

FDA approved Olaparib for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline or somatic homologous recombination repair (HRR) gene-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) who have progressed following prior treatment with enzalutamide or abiraterone.

FDA approved Olaparib for the adjuvant treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious gBRCAm human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative high risk early breast cancer who have been treated with neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy.

FDA approved Olaparib for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline or somatic BRCA-mutated recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer, who are in complete or partial response to platinum-based chemotherapy.

EMA approved olaparib for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with advanced (FIGO stages III and IV) BRCA1/2-mutated (germline and/or somatic) high-grade epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who are in response (complete or partial) following completion of first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.

EMA approved olaparib, as monotherapy or in combination with endocrine therapy for the adjuvant treatment of adult patients with germline BRCA1/2-mutated (gBRCAm), HER2-negative, high-risk early breast cancer who have previously received neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy.

EMA approved olaparib for the treatment of adult patients with germline BRCA1/2-mutations, who have HER2 negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. Patients should have previously been treated with an anthracycline and a taxane in the (neo)adjuvant or metastatic setting unless patients were not suitable for these treatments (see section 5.1). Patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive breast cancer should also have progressed on or after prior endocrine therapy, or be considered unsuitable for endocrine therapy.

EMA approved olaparib for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with germline BRCA1/2-mutations who have metastatic adenocarcinoma of the pancreas and have not progressed after a minimum of 16 weeks of platinum treatment within a first-line chemotherapy regimen.

EMA approved olaparib as monotherapy for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) and BRCA1/2-mutations (germline and/or somatic) who have progressed following prior therapy that included a new hormonal agent.

EMA has approved durvalumab in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel is indicated for the first-line treatment of adults with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer who are candidates for systemic therapy, followed by maintenance treatment with durvalumab in combination with olaparib in endometrial cancer that is mismatch repair proficient (pMMR).

drug.drug_mechanism_cn: Rucaparib是一种多聚(adp -核糖)聚合酶(PARP)的抑制剂，包括PARP-1, PARP-2和PARP-3，在DNA修复中发挥作用。体外研究表明，rucaparib诱导的细胞毒性可能会抑制PARP酶活性和促进PARP-DNA复合物的形成，从而导致DNA损伤、细胞凋亡和癌细胞死亡。在BRCA1/2和其他DNA修复基因缺失的肿瘤细胞系中观察到rucaparib诱导的细胞毒性和抗肿瘤活性增加。Rucaparib已被证明在人类癌症的小鼠异种移植模型中降低肿瘤生长，无论是否存在BRCA缺失。
adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准鲁卡帕尼用于携带BRCA胚系或体系有害突变的、接受过雄激素受体的治疗及基于紫杉醇的方案化疗的转移性去势抵抗前列腺癌（mCRPC）成人患者的治疗。
FDA批准鲁卡帕尼用于对铂类化疗完全或部分反应的复发性上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成年患者的维持治疗。
FDA批准鲁卡帕尼用于携带有害BRCA突变（胚系和/或体细胞）、对铂类化疗完全或部分缓解的复发性上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成年患者的维持治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: FDA approved Rucaparib for the treatment of adult patients with a deleterious BRCA mutation (germline and/or somatic)-associated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) who have been treated with androgen receptor-directed therapy and a taxane-based chemotherapy.

FDA approved RUBRACA for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with a deleterious BRCA mutation (germline and/or somatic)- associated recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who are in a complete or partial response to platinum-based chemotherapy.

drug.drug_mechanism_cn: 卡铂的主要作用是将烷基连接到核苷酸上，导致单加合物的形成，以及当修复酶试图纠正错误时 DNA 片段化。 2% 的卡铂活性来自 DNA 从一条链上的碱基到另一条上碱基的交联，从而防止 DNA 链分离以进行合成或转录。卡铂可以诱导许多不同的突变。
adaptation_disease_cn: NMPA批准帕博利珠单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇适用于转移性鳞状非小细胞肺癌(NSCLC)患者的一线治疗。
FDA批准帕博利珠单抗+卡铂+紫杉醇或蛋白结合的紫杉醇用于鳞状非小细胞肺癌患者的一线治疗。
NMPA批准替雷利珠单抗联合紫杉醇和卡铂用于局部晚期或转移性鳞状非小细胞肺癌的一线治疗。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合卡铂、紫杉醇用于不可切除、局部晚期、复发或转移性非鳞非小细胞肺癌患者的一线治疗。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇用于初始手术切除后III或IV期上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌的治疗。
NMPA批准舒格利单抗联合培美曲塞和卡铂用于表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）基因突变阴性和间变性淋巴瘤激酶（ALK）阴性的转移性非鳞状非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的一线治疗。
NMPA批准舒格利单抗联合紫杉醇和卡铂用于转移性鳞状非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的一线治疗。
NMPA批准特瑞普利单抗联合培美曲塞和铂类用于表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）基因突变阴性和间变性淋巴瘤激酶（ALK）阴性、不可手术切除的局部晚期或转移性非鳞状非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的一线治疗。
FDA批准度伐利尤单抗联合依托泊苷和卡铂/顺铂用于广泛期小细胞肺癌（ES-SCLC）成人患者的一线治疗。
NMPA批准度伐利尤单抗联合依托泊苷和卡铂或顺铂，作为ES-SCLC成人患者的一线治疗。
EMA批准度伐利尤单抗联合依托泊苷及卡铂或顺铂，用于广泛期小细胞肺癌（ES-SCLC）成人患者的一线治疗。
NMPA批准斯鲁利单抗联合卡铂和白蛋白紫杉醇适用于不可手术切除的局部晚期或转移性鳞状非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的一线治疗。
NMPA批准斯鲁利单抗联合卡铂和依托泊苷适用于广泛期小细胞肺癌（ES-SCLC）的一线治疗。
NMPA批准卡瑞利珠单抗联合培美曲塞和卡铂用于表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）基因突变阴性和间变性淋巴瘤激酶（ALK）阴性的、不可手术切除的局部晚期或转移性非鳞状非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的一线治疗。
NMPA批准曲妥珠单抗用于HER2阳性的早期乳腺癌：接受了手术、含蒽环类抗生素辅助化疗和放疗（如果适用）后的单药辅助治疗；多柔比星和环磷酰胺化疗后序贯曲妥珠单抗与紫杉醇或多西他赛的联合辅助治疗；与多西他赛和卡铂联合的辅助治疗。
NMPA批准阿得贝利单抗联合依托泊苷和卡铂一线治疗广泛期小细胞肺癌（ES-SCLC）。
FDA批准Dostarlimab-gxly联合卡铂和紫杉醇化疗，序贯Dostarlimab-gxly单药用于治疗dMMR/MSI-H的原发性晚期或复发性子宫内膜癌（EC）成人患者。
EMA批准Dostarlimab（Dostarlimab-gxly）联合卡铂和紫杉醇用于一线治疗成人原发性晚期或复发性子宫内膜癌（EC）且适合接受全身治疗的患者。
NMPA批准奥希替尼联合培美曲塞和顺铂/卡铂用于携带EGFR exon19 del或L858R突变的局部晚期或转移性非小细胞肺癌成人患者的一线治疗。
FDA批准奥希替尼联合培美曲塞和顺铂/卡铂用于携带EGFR exon19 del或L858R突变的局部晚期或转移性非小细胞肺癌的一线治疗。
EMA批准奥希替尼（TAGRISSO）联合培美曲塞及铂类化疗，用于携带EGFR 19号外显子缺失或21号外显子（L858R）替换突变的晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）成人患者的一线治疗。
FDA批准Amivantamab-vmjw联合卡铂+培美曲塞用于携带EGFR基因20号外显子插入突变的局部晚期或转移性非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的一线治疗。
FDA批准amivantamab-vmjw联合卡铂和培美曲塞用于治疗携带EGFR exon19 del或L858R突变且在使用EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂治疗时或治疗后进展的局部晚期或转移性非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）成人患者。
NMPA批准埃万妥单抗与卡铂和培美曲塞联合给药，用于经检测确认携带表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）20号外显子插入突变的局部晚期或转移性非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）成人患者的一线治疗。
NMPA批准埃万妥单抗（Amivantamab）联合卡铂和培美曲塞用于治疗携带EGFR exon19 del或L858R突变且在EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂治疗期间或之后疾病进展的局部晚期或转移性非鳞非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）成人患者。
EMA批准Amivantamab（Rybrevant）与卡铂和培美曲塞联合用于既往接受过EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（TKI）等治疗后失败的、携带EGFR基因19号外显子缺失或21号外显子L858R突变的成人晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的治疗。
EMA批准Amivantamab（Rybrevant）与卡铂和培美曲塞联合用于携带EGFR基因20号外显子插入激活突变的成人晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的一线治疗。
NMPA批准依沃西单抗注射液联合培美曲塞和卡铂，用于经表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（TKI）治疗后进展的EGFR基因突变阳性的局部晚期或转移性非鳞状非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的治疗。
FDA批准度伐利尤单抗联合卡铂、紫杉醇治疗序贯度伐利尤单抗维持治疗dMMR的原发性晚期或复发性子宫内膜癌成人患者。
EMA批准度伐利尤单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇适用于作为系统治疗候选者的原发性晚期或复发性子宫内膜癌成人患者的一线治疗， 对于错配修复正常（pMMR）型子宫内膜癌，使用度伐利尤单抗联合奥拉帕利进行维持治疗。
EMA批准度伐利尤单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇适用于作为系统治疗候选者的原发性晚期或复发性子宫内膜癌成人患者的一线治疗， 对于错配修复缺陷（dMMR）型子宫内膜癌，使用度伐利尤单抗进行单药维持治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: EMA has apporved durvalumab  in combination with etoposide and either carboplatin or cisplatin is indicated for the first-line treatment of adults with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC).

EMA approved dostarlimab (dostarlimab-gxly) in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel for the first-line treatment of adult patients with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer (EC) who are candidates for systemic therapy.

EMA approved Osimertinib (TAGRISSO) in combination with pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy for the first-line treatment of adult patients with advanced NSCLC whose tumours have EGFR exon 19 deletions or exon 21 (L858R) substitution mutations.

EMA approved Amivantamab (Rybrevant) in combination with carboplatin and pemetrexed for the treatment of adult patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring EGFR exon 19 deletions or exon 21 L858R mutations after failure of prior therapy including an EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI).

EMA approved Amivantamab (Rybrevant) in combination with carboplatin and pemetrexed for the first-line treatment of adult patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring activating EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations.

EMA has approved durvalumab in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel is indicated for the first-line treatment of adults with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer who are candidates for systemic therapy, followed by maintenance treatment with durvalumab in combination with olaparib in endometrial cancer that is mismatch repair proficient (pMMR).

EMA has approved durvalumab in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel is indicated for the first-line treatment of adults with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer who are candidates for systemic therapy, followed by maintenance treatment with durvalumab ias monotherapy in endometrial cancer that is mismatch repair deficient (dMMR).

drug.drug_mechanism_cn: Regorafenib（瑞格菲尼）是多种与细胞膜结合的胞内激酶的小分子抑制剂，参与正常的细胞功能以及病理过程，例如肿瘤发生，肿瘤血管生成，转移和肿瘤免疫。 在体外生化或细胞分析中，在临床上已达到的Regorafenib浓度下，Regorafenib或其主要人类活性代谢产物M-2和M-5抑制RET，VEGFR1，VEGFR2，VEGFR3，KIT，PDGFR-alpha，PDGFR-beta，FGFR1，FGFR2，TIE2， DDR2，TrkA，Eph2A，RAF-1，BRAF，BRAF V600E，SAPK2，PTK5，Abl和CSF1R的活性。 在体内模型中，Regorafenib在大鼠肿瘤模型中显示出抗血管生成活性，并在几种小鼠异种移植模型中显示出对肿瘤生长的抑制作用，其中包括对人结肠直肠癌，胃肠道间质癌和肝细胞癌的某些模型。 Regorafenib还在人大肠癌的小鼠异种移植模型和两个原位小鼠模型中显示出抗转移活性。
adaptation_disease_cn: NMPA批准瑞戈非尼用于治疗既往接受过以氟尿嘧啶、奥沙利铂和伊立替康为基础的化疗, 以及既往接受过或不适合接受抗VEGF治疗、抗EGFR治疗（RAS野生型）的转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）患者。
FDA批准瑞戈非尼用于治疗既往接受过以氟尿嘧啶、奥沙利铂和伊立替康为基础的化疗, 以及抗VEGF治疗、抗EGFR治疗（KRAS野生型）的转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）患者。
FDA批准瑞戈非尼用于既往接受过甲磺酸伊马替尼及苹果酸舒尼替尼治疗的局部晚期、不可切除或转移性胃肠道间质瘤患者。
FDA批准瑞戈非尼用于既往接受过索拉非尼治疗的肝细胞癌（HCC）患者。

NMPA批准瑞戈非尼用于治疗既往接受过甲磺酸伊马替尼及苹果酸舒尼替尼治疗的局部晚期的、无法手术切除的或转移性的胃肠道间质瘤（GIST）患者。
NMPA批准瑞戈非尼用于治疗既往接受过索拉非尼治疗的肝细胞癌（HCC）患者。
adaptation_disease_en: Regorafenib is indicated for the treatment of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC) who have been previously treated with fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin- and irinotecan-based chemotherapy, an anti-VEGF therapy, and, if KRAS wild type, an anti-EGFR therapy.

Regorafenib is indicated for the treatment of patients with locally advanced, unresectable or metastatic gastrointestinal stromal tumour (GIST) who have been previously treated with imatinib mesylate and sunitinib malate.
Regorafenib is indicated for the treatment of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) previously treated with sorafenib.

adaptation_disease_cn: NMPA批准西妥昔单抗与FOLFOX/FOLFIRI方案联合用于RAS野生型的转移性结直肠癌的一线治疗。
FDA批准西妥昔单抗联合FOLFIRI用于K-Ras 野生型、EGFR 表达的转移性结直肠癌患者的一线治疗。
EMA批准帕尼单抗+FOLFIRI用于一线含氟尿嘧啶化疗（不含伊利替康）后的RAS野生型转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）成年患者的二线治疗。
EMA批准帕尼单抗+FOLFIRI用于RAS野生型转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）成年患者的一线治疗。
FDA批准雷莫西尤单抗联合FOLFIRI用于既往经含贝伐珠单抗、奥沙利铂、氟尿嘧啶化疗进展的、转移性结直肠癌患者的治疗。
FDA批准ziv-阿柏西普联合FOLFIRI用于既往经含奥沙利铂化疗进展或抗性的转移性结直肠癌患者。
NMPA批准西妥昔单抗β与FOLFIRI方案联合用于一线治疗RAS/BRAF基因野生型的转移性结直肠癌。
adaptation_disease_en: EMA approved panitumumab in second-line in combination with FOLFIRI for patients who have received first-line fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy (excluding irinotecan).
EMA approved panitumumab in first-line in combination with FOLFIRI for the treatment of adult patients with wild-type RAS metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).

drug.drug_mechanism_cn: Panitumumab与正常和肿瘤细胞上的EGFR特异性结合，并竞争性抑制EGFR配体的结合。 非临床研究表明，Panitumumab与EGFR结合可阻止配体诱导的受体自磷酸化和受体相关激酶的激活，从而抑制细胞生长，诱导凋亡，减少促炎细胞因子和血管生长因子的产生以及EGFR的内化。 体外测定和体内动物研究表明，Panitumumab可以抑制表达EGFR的某些人类肿瘤细胞系的生长和存活。
adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准帕尼单抗用于接受含氟尿嘧啶、奥沙利铂和伊立替康的化疗后进展的RAS（KRAS/NRAS）野生型，转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）患者的治疗。
EMA批准帕尼单抗用于经含氟尿嘧啶、奥沙利铂和伊立替康化疗失败后的RAS野生型转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）成年患者的治疗。
FDA批准帕尼单抗联合FOLFOX，用于RAS（KRAS/NRAS）野生型、转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）患者的一线治疗。
EMA批准帕尼单抗+FOLFOX用于RAS野生型转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）成年患者的一线治疗。
FDA批准Sotorasib联合帕尼单抗用于既往接受过氟尿嘧啶/奥沙利铂/伊利替康为基础的化疗的、携带KRAS G12C突变的转移性结直肠癌患者的治疗。
EMA批准帕尼单抗+FOLFIRI用于一线含氟尿嘧啶化疗（不含伊利替康）后的RAS野生型转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）成年患者的二线治疗。
EMA批准帕尼单抗+FOLFIRI用于RAS野生型转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）成年患者的一线治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: EMA approved panitumumab for the treatment of adult patients with RAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer after failure of fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin-, and irinotecan-containing chemotherapy regimens.
EMA approved panitumumab in first-line in combination with FOLFOX for the treatment of adult patients with wild-type RAS metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).
EMA approved panitumumab in second-line in combination with FOLFIRI for patients who have received first-line fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy (excluding irinotecan).
EMA approved panitumumab in first-line in combination with FOLFIRI for the treatment of adult patients with wild-type RAS metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).

drug.drug_mechanism_cn: 贝伐珠单抗结合VEGF并阻止VEGF与其在内皮细胞表面的受体（Flt-1和KDR）相互作用。 在血管生成的体外模型中，VEGF与其受体的相互作用导致内皮细胞增殖和新血管形成。 在裸鼠结肠癌异种移植模型中应用贝伐珠单抗可降低微血管生长和抑制转移性疾病的进展。
adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准贝伐珠单抗用于治疗复发性胶质母细胞瘤成人患者。
NMPA批准贝伐珠单抗用于成人复发性胶质母细胞瘤患者的治疗。
EMA批准阿瓦斯汀（Avastin，贝伐珠单抗）与静脉注射的 5-氟尿嘧啶/亚叶酸钙或静脉注射的 5-氟尿嘧啶/亚叶酸钙/伊立替康联合使用，适用于转移性结肠癌或直肠癌患者的一线治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利联合贝伐珠单抗用于一线铂类为基础的化疗完全或部分缓解的、HRD阳性的晚期卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成人患者的治疗，其中HRD阳性定义为携带BRCA有害或疑似有害突变或基因组不稳定。
NMPA批准奥拉帕利联合贝伐珠单抗用于同源重组修复缺陷（HRD）阳性的晚期上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成人患者在一线含铂化疗联合贝伐珠单抗治疗达到完全缓解或部分缓解后的维持治疗。
EMA批准奥拉帕利联合贝伐珠单抗用于成年晚期（FIGO III–IV期）高级别上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌患者的维持治疗，患者在完成一线含铂化疗联合贝伐珠单抗后达到治疗反应（完全缓解或部分缓解），且其肿瘤具有HRD阳性状态。HRD阳性定义为符合以下任一条件：BRCA1/2突变阳性；和/或基因组不稳定性（genomic instability）阳性。
NMPA批准贝伐珠单抗联合以氟嘧啶为基础的化疗适用于转移性结直肠癌患者的治疗。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合以氟尿嘧啶为基础的化疗用于转移性结直肠癌的一线或二线治疗。
NMPA批准贝伐珠单抗联合以铂类为基础的化疗用于不可切除的晚期、转移性或复发性非鳞状细胞非小细胞肺癌患者的一线治疗。
FDA批准帕博利珠单抗+化疗±贝伐珠单抗用于PD-L1表达阳性（CPS≥1）的持续的、复发的或转移性的宫颈癌患者。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合阿替利珠单抗用于疗既往未接受全身治疗的不可切除或转移性HCC患者。
NMPA批准贝伐珠单抗联合阿替利珠单抗治疗既往未接受过全身系统性治疗的不可切除肝细胞癌患者。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合氟尿嘧啶-伊立替康为基础的化疗或氟尿嘧啶-奥沙利铂为基础的化疗方案作为一线接受过含贝伐珠单抗治疗后进展的转移性结直肠癌患者的二线治疗。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合氟尿嘧啶-伊立替康为基础的化疗或氟尿嘧啶-奥沙利铂为基础的化疗方案作为一线接受过含贝伐珠单抗治疗后进展的转移性结直肠癌患者的二线治疗。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合卡铂、紫杉醇用于不可切除、局部晚期、复发或转移性非鳞非小细胞肺癌患者的一线治疗。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇用于初始手术切除后III或IV期上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌的治疗。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合紫杉醇、顺铂或紫杉醇、拓朴替康用于治疗持续性、复发或转移性宫颈癌。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合紫杉醇、顺铂或紫杉醇、拓朴替康用于治疗持续性、复发或转移性宫颈癌。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合紫杉醇、聚乙二醇多柔比星或拓扑替康用于治疗铂类耐药的之前接受过不超过2种化疗方案的复发性上皮卵巢、输卵管或原发性腹膜癌。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合紫杉醇、聚乙二醇多柔比星或拓扑替康用于治疗铂类耐药的之前接受过不超过2种化疗方案的复发性上皮卵巢、输卵管或原发性腹膜癌。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗联合紫杉醇、聚乙二醇多柔比星或拓扑替康用于治疗铂类耐药的之前接受过不超过2种化疗方案的复发性上皮卵巢、输卵管或原发性腹膜癌。
FDA批准贝伐珠单抗与α干扰素联合用于治疗转移性肾细胞癌。
NMPA批准信迪利单抗联合贝伐珠单抗，用于既往未接受过系统治疗的不可切除或转移性肝细胞癌的一线治疗。
NMPA批准信迪利单抗联合贝伐珠单抗、培美曲塞和顺铂用于经表皮生长因子受体酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（EGFR-TKI）治疗失败的EGFR基因突变的局部晚期或转移性非鳞状非小细胞肺癌患者的治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: The EMA has approved the use of Avastin (bevacizumab) in combination with intravenous 5-fluorouracil/leucovorin or intravenous 5-fluorouracil/leucovorin/irinotecan for the first-line treatment of patients with metastatic colon cancer or rectal cancer.

FDA approved Olaparib in combination with bevacizumab for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary 
peritoneal cancer who are in complete or partial response to first-line platinum-based chemotherapy and whose cancer is associated with homologous recombination deficiency (HRD)-positive status defined by either: a deleterious or suspected deleterious BRCA mutation, and/or genomic instability.

EMA approved olaparib in combination with bevacizumab for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with advanced (FIGO stages III and IV) high-grade epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who are in response (complete or partial) following completion of first-line platinum-based chemotherapy in combination with bevacizumab and whose tumors are HRD-positive, defined as either BRCA1/2 mutation-positive and/or genomic instability-positive.

drug.drug_mechanism_cn: 依维莫司是PI3K / AKT通路下游的雷帕霉素（sTOR-s苏氨酸激酶）哺乳动物靶标的抑制剂。该mTOR通路在几种人类癌症和结节性硬化复合物（TSC）中失调。细胞内蛋白FKBP-12，与mTOR复合物1（mTORC1）形成抑制性复合物，从而抑制mTOR激酶活性。依维莫司降低S6核糖体蛋白激酶（S6K1）和真核起始因子4E结合蛋白（4E -BP1），mTOR的下游效应子，参与蛋白质合成，S6K1是mTORC1的底物，磷酸化雌激素受体的激活结构域1，导致受体的配体非依赖性激活；依维莫司抑制缺氧的表达。诱导因子（例如HIF-1）并降低血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）的表达，依维莫司对mTOR的抑制作用可降低细胞增殖体外和/或体内研究中的血管生成，血管生成和葡萄糖摄取。 PI3K / Akt / mTOR途径的组成性激活可以促进乳腺癌的内分泌抵抗力。体外研究表明，雌激素依赖性和HER2 +乳腺癌细胞对依维莫司的抑制作用敏感，并且依维莫司和Akt，HER2或芳香酶抑制剂的联合治疗以协同方式增强了依维莫司的抗肿瘤活性.2 mTORC1信号的调节剂是癌基因抑制物结核菌硬化复合物1和2（TSC1，TSC2）。 TSC1或TSC2的丢失或失活导致下游信号传导的激活。在TSC中，一种遗传性疾病会导致TSC1或TSC2基因的失活突变导致错构瘤在全身的形成以及癫痫发作和癫痫发生。 mTOR的过度激活会导致神经元发育异常，轴突发生异常和树突形成，兴奋性突触电流增加，髓鞘减少以及皮质层状结构破坏。导致神经元发育和功能异常。在大脑中mTOR失调的动物模型中用mTOR抑制剂治疗可抑制癫痫发作，预防新发癫痫发作的发生并防止过早死亡。
adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准依维莫司用于治疗无法手术切除、局部晚期或转移性的进展期胰腺神经内分泌瘤（PNET）患者和无法手术切除、局部晚期或转移性、分化良好、进展期非功能性胃肠道或肺源性神经内分泌瘤（NET）成年患者。
FDA批准依维莫司用于经舒尼替尼或索拉非尼治疗失败后晚期肾细胞癌（RCC）成年患者的治疗。
FDA批准依维莫司用于无需立即手术治疗、结节性硬化症（TSC）相关的肾血管平滑肌脂肪瘤成年患者。
FDA批准依维莫司用于无法根治性手术切除、需干预治疗的结节性硬化症（TSC）相关的室管膜下巨细胞星形细胞瘤（SEGA）成年或1岁及以上儿童患者的治疗。
NMPA批准依维莫司用于需要治疗干预但不适合手术切除的结节性硬化症（TSC）相关的室管膜下巨细胞星形细胞瘤（SEGA）成人和儿童患者。（本品的有效性主要通过可持续的SEGA肿瘤体积的缩小来证明，尚未证明TSC相关的SEGA患者能否获得疾病相关症状改善和总生存期延长。）
NMPA批准依维莫司用于治疗不需立即手术治疗的结节性硬化症相关的肾血管平滑肌脂肪瘤（TSC-AML）成年患者。
NMPA批准依维莫司用于治疗既往接受舒尼替尼或索拉非尼治疗失败的晚期肾细胞癌（RCC）成年患者。
NMPA批准依维莫司用于治疗不可手术切除的、局部晚期或转移性的、分化良好的（中度分化或高度分化）进展期胰腺神经内分泌瘤（PNET）成年患者。
NMPA批准依维莫司用于治疗无法手术切除的、局部晚期或转移性的、分化良好的、进展期非功能性胃肠道或肺源神经内分泌瘤（NET）成年患者。
FDA批准仑伐替尼联合依维莫司用于治疗经抗血管生成治疗后的晚期肾细胞癌（RCC）患者。
FDA批准依维莫司联合依西美坦用于经来曲唑或阿那曲唑治疗失败的绝经后晚期HR+、HER2-的乳腺癌患者。
EMA 批准依维莫司联合依西美坦，用于经非甾体芳香化酶抑制剂（来曲唑或阿那曲唑）治疗后复发或进展、无内脏症状的绝经后 HR+、HER2‑晚期乳腺癌患者。
NMPA批准伏罗尼布与依维莫司联合，用于既往接受过酪氨酸激酶抑制剂治疗失败的晚期肾细胞癌患者的治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: FDA approved Everolimus for the treatment of adult patients with progressive neuroendocrine tumors of pancreatic origin (PNET) with unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic disease；for the treatment of adult patients with progressive, well-differentiated, non-functional NET of gastrointestinal (GI) or lung origin with unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic disease.
FDA approved Everolimus for the treatment of adult patients with advanced RCC after failure of treatment with sunitinib or sorafenib.
FDA approved Everolimus for the treatment of adult patients with renal angiomyolipoma and TSC, not requiring immediate surgery.
FDA approved Everolimus in adult and pediatric patients aged 1 year and older with TSC for the treatment of SEGA that requires therapeutic intervention but cannot be curatively resected.

FDA approved Everolimus for the treatment of postmenopausal women with advanced hormone receptor-positive, HER2­ negative breast cancer in combination with exemestane, after failure of treatment with letrozole or anastrozole.

EMA approved everolimus in combination with exemestane for postmenopausal women with HR‑positive, HER2‑negative advanced breast cancer without symptomatic visceral disease, with disease relapse or progression after non‑steroidal aromatase inhibitor (letrozole or anastrozole) treatment.

drug.drug_mechanism_cn: CMAB009（西妥昔单抗β）是一种专门靶向人表皮生长因子受体 （EGFR） 的重组人/小鼠嵌合单克隆抗体 （mAb），竞争性抑制配体结合和相互关联的下游信号传导。它具有与 ERBITUX （西妥昔单抗） 相同的氨基酸序列，但糖基化和其他翻译后修饰 （PTM） 的能力略有不同。CMAB009 由中国仓鼠卵巢 （CHO） 细胞表达，而西妥昔单抗由小鼠细胞系 SP2/0 表达，该细胞系也表达 α-1,3-半乳糖基转移酶基因。在大多数对西妥昔单抗产生超敏反应的患者中，发现在治疗开始前他们的血清中已经存在针对西妥昔单抗的 IgE 抗体。发现这些抗体对半乳糖-α-1,3-半乳糖 （Gal （α 1-3） Gal） 具有特异性。由于 CHO 细胞不产生 α-1,3-半乳糖基转移酶，因此它们具有与 SP2/0 不同的糖基化模式，因此，在 CHO 细胞中表达的 CMAB009 具有较低水平的含 Gal （α 1-3） Gal 聚糖。这表明与西妥昔单抗相比，CMAB009可能具有较低的免疫原性和较少的超敏反应。
adaptation_disease_cn: NMPA批准西妥昔单抗β与FOLFIRI方案联合用于一线治疗RAS/BRAF基因野生型的转移性结直肠癌。

drug.drug_mechanism_cn: 呋喹替尼是一具有高度选择性的肿瘤血管生成抑制剂，其主要作用靶点是VEGFR激酶家族VEGFR1， 2及3。呋喹替尼在分子水平可抑制VEGFR激酶的活性；在细胞水平上可抑制VEGFR2/3的磷酸化，抑制内皮细胞的增殖及管腔形成；在组织水平上，呋喹替尼可明显抑制鸡胚绒毛尿囊膜模型新生微血管的形成；在整体动物水平上，呋喹替尼口服后可抑制VEGFR2/3磷酸化，抑制肿瘤血管生成，从而抑制肿瘤生长。在整体动物上，呋喹替尼采用一日一次给药，对结直肠癌以及其它多种类型肿瘤模型的生长均显示强效且剂量依赖性的抑制效应，在敏感模型上发现肿瘤缩小和消退。
adaptation_disease_cn: NMPA已经批准呋喹替尼单药适用于既往接受过氟尿嘧啶类、奥沙利铂和伊立替康为基础的化疗，以及既往接受过或不适合接受抗血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）治疗、抗表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）治疗（RAS野生型）的转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）患者。
FDA批准呋喹替尼用于治疗既往接受过氟尿嘧啶、奥沙利铂和伊立替康为基础化疗，抗VEGF治疗、抗EGFR治疗（RAS野生型）的转移性结直肠癌成年患者。

drug.drug_mechanism_cn: 根据建模研究，预测达沙替尼可与ABL激酶的多种构象结合。 在甲磺酸伊马替尼敏感和耐药型的白血病细胞系中，达沙替尼均表现出体外活性。 达沙替尼可抑制过表达BCR-ABL的慢性粒细胞白血病（CML）和急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）细胞的生长。 达沙替尼可克服因BCR-ABL激酶结构域突变、SRC家族激酶（LYN，HCK）的旁信号通路的激活以及多药耐药基因过表达而引起的伊马替尼耐药性。
adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准达沙替尼(dasatinib)用于治疗新确诊的费城染色体阳性（Ph+）慢性粒细胞白血病（CML）成年患者。

FDA批准达沙替尼(dasatinib)联合化疗用于治疗1岁及以上新确诊为费城染色体阳性（Ph+）的急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）的儿科患者。
FDA批准达沙替尼(dasatinib)用于治疗对其他疗法无效或不能耐受的费城染色体阳性（Ph+）的急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）成年患者。

FDA批准达沙替尼(dasatinib)用于治疗1岁及以上慢性期费城染色体阳性（Ph+）慢性粒细胞白血病（CML）的儿科患者。
FDA批准达沙替尼(dasatinib)用于治疗对伊马替尼等一线药物化疗不敏感的各期费城染色体阳性（Ph+）慢性粒细胞白血病（CML）成年患者。

io_gene_clinical.evidence: 有研究表明，p53可通过miR-34调节PD-L1表达（PMID:26577528）。一项对公共数据库中肺腺癌患者的基因组、转录组、蛋白质组及临床数据的整合分析的研究中发现，TP53突变能显著提高免疫检查点的表达并激活T细胞效应因子和γ干扰素；TP53/KRAS共突变可提高PD-L1表达，且共突变组总具有最高的PD-L1+/CD8A+比例；进一步研究发现TP53或KRAS突变可导致一些列与细胞周期调节、DNA复制和DNA损伤修复相关的基因的改变。对公开的临床试验及真实临床数据的回顾分析进一步确认，TP53或KRAS突变的患者，尤其是TP53/KRAS共突变的患者，用PD-1抑制剂治疗具有显著的临床获益（PMID:28039262）。一项对31例接受pembrolizumab治疗的非小细胞肺癌患者的回顾性分析显示，TP53突变(STK11及EGFR野生型)的肺腺癌患者接受抗PD-1治疗后其无进展生存期更长(P＜0.001) （PMID:29764856）。
io_gene_clinical.test_significance: TP53突变可能为免疫治疗正向预测因子。

io_gene_clinical.evidence: 有数据表明免疫治疗疗效与肿瘤微环境中CD8+T细胞渗透水平相关，一项针对黑色素瘤免疫治疗内源性耐药的机制的研究发现，肿瘤组织中T细胞基因表达缺失与WNT/β-catenin信号通路激活相关，并通过黑色素瘤小鼠模型证实，β-catenin信号路激活可导致T细胞排出并对抗PD-L1/抗CTLA-4单克隆抗体耐药。该研究中发现，β-catenin通路的负调控基因APC、AXIN1、TCF1的失活突变和β-catenin（CTNNB1）激活性突变在无T细胞渗透的肿瘤中均具有较高的比例（11％和7.7％）（PMID:25970248）。
io_gene_clinical.test_significance: WNT信号通路激活可能为免疫药物疗效的负向预测因子。

io_gene_clinical.evidence: 一项体外研究中，研究者通过在肿瘤细胞系中进行蛋白质组学筛选发现，ARID1A与错配修复蛋白（MMR）MSH2相互作用，它在DNA复制过程中招募MSH2到染色质中以提高错配修复；而ARID1A失活导致错配修复水平降低，突变增多；研究者对TCGA数据库中的样品进行分析证实，在多种人类肿瘤中，ARID1A失活与MSI、突变负荷升高相关。在ARID1A缺陷的卵巢癌小鼠模型中，还发现肿瘤淋巴细胞渗透和PD-L1表达升高，且PD-L1抗体可降低肿瘤负荷并延长其生存期（PMID: 29736026）。
io_gene_clinical.test_significance: ARID1A突变是肿瘤样本中最常见的突变基因之一，突变可能为免疫治疗正向预测因子。

clinic_trial.study_title: Cetuximab in Third Line for Mutant APC, TP53 and RAS Patients With Refractory Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
Trametinib + HDM201 in CRC Patients With RAS/RAF Mutant and TP53 Wild-type Advanced/Metastatic Colorectal Cancer Mutant and TP53 Wild-type (TRAHD)

drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: An inhibitor of ataxia telangiectasia and rad3-related (ATR) kinase, a DNA damage response kinase, with potential antineoplastic activity. Upon administration, berzosertib selectively binds to and inhibits ATR kinase activity and prevents ATR-mediated signaling in the ATR-checkpoint kinase 1 (Chk1) signaling pathway. This prevents DNA damage checkpoint activation, disrupts DNA damage repair, and induces tumor cell apoptosis. ATR, a serine/threonine protein kinase upregulated in a variety of cancer cell types, plays a key role in DNA repair, cell cycle progression, and survival; it is activated by DNA damage caused during DNA replication-associated stress.

An orally bioavailable imidazoquinoline targeting the phosphatidylinositol 3 kinase (PI3K) and the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR), with potential antineoplastic activity. Dactolisib inhibits PI3K kinase and mTOR kinase in the PI3K/AKT/mTOR kinase signaling pathway, which may result in tumor cell apoptosis and growth inhibition in PI3K/mTOR-overexpressing tumor cells. Activation of the PI3K/mTOR pathway promotes cell growth, survival, and resistance to chemotherapy and radiotherapy; mTOR, a serine/threonine kinase downstream of PI3K, may also be activated independent of PI3K.

An inhibitor of embryonic ectoderm development protein (EED) and allosteric inhibitor of polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2), with potential antineoplastic activity. Upon administration, MAK683 selectively binds to the domain of EED that interacts with trimethylated lysine 27 on histone 3 (H3K27me3), which leads to a conformational change in the EED H3K27me3-binding pocket and prevents the interaction of EED with the histone methyltransferase enhancer zeste homolog 2 (EZH2). Disruption of the EED-EZH2 protein-protein interaction (PPI) results in a loss of H3K27me3-stimulated PRC2 activity and prevents H3K27 trimethylation. This decrease in histone methylation alters gene expression patterns associated with cancer pathways and results in decreased tumor cell proliferation in EZH2-mutated and PRC2-dependent cancer cells. PRC2, a histone H3 lysine 27 methyltransferase and multi-protein complex comprised of EZH2, EED and suppressor of zeste 12 (SUZ12), plays a key role in gene regulation, especially during embryonic development. EZH2, the catalytic subunit of PRC2, is overexpressed or mutated in a variety of cancer cells. EED is essential for the histone methyltransferase activity of PRC2 because EED directly binds to H3K27me3.

An orally available selective inhibitor of the histone lysine methyltransferase (HMT) enhancer of zeste homolog 2 (EZH2), with potential antineoplastic activity. Upon oral administration, EZH2 inhibitor CPI-0209 selectively targets, binds to and inhibits the activity of EZH2. Inhibition of EZH2 specifically prevents the methylation of histone H3 on lysine 27 (H3K27). This decrease in histone methylation alters gene expression patterns associated with cancer pathways and results in decreased proliferation of EZH2-expressing cancer cells. EZH2, an HMT class enzyme and the catalytic subunit of the polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2), is overexpressed or mutated in a variety of cancer cells and plays a key role in tumor cell proliferation; its expression is correlated with tumor initiation, progression, stem cell self-renewal, migration and angiogenesis.

An orally available selective inhibitor of the histone lysine methyltransferase EZH2, with potential antineoplastic activity. Upon oral administration, CPI-1205 selectively inhibits the activity of both wild-type and mutated forms of EZH2. Inhibition of EZH2 specifically prevents the methylation of histone H3 on lysine 27 (H3K27). This decrease in histone methylation alters gene expression patterns associated with cancer pathways and results in decreased proliferation of EZH2-expressing cancer cells. EZH2, a histone lysine methyltransferase (HMT) class enzyme and the catalytic subunit of the polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2), is overexpressed or mutated in a variety of cancer cells and plays a key role in tumor cell proliferation; its expression is correlated with tumor initiation, progression, stem cell self-renewal, migration and angiogenesis.

adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准帕尼单抗用于接受含氟尿嘧啶、奥沙利铂和伊立替康的化疗后进展的RAS（KRAS/NRAS）野生型，转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）患者的治疗。
EMA批准帕尼单抗用于经含氟尿嘧啶、奥沙利铂和伊立替康化疗失败后的RAS野生型转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）成年患者的治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: EMA approved panitumumab for the treatment of adult patients with RAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer after failure of fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin-, and irinotecan-containing chemotherapy regimens.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: Panitumumab与正常和肿瘤细胞上的EGFR特异性结合，并竞争性抑制EGFR配体的结合。 非临床研究表明，Panitumumab与EGFR结合可阻止配体诱导的受体自磷酸化和受体相关激酶的激活，从而抑制细胞生长，诱导凋亡，减少促炎细胞因子和血管生长因子的产生以及EGFR的内化。 体外测定和体内动物研究表明，Panitumumab可以抑制表达EGFR的某些人类肿瘤细胞系的生长和存活。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: A human monoclonal antibody produced in transgenic mice that attaches to the transmembrane epidermal growth factor (EGF) receptor. Panitumumab may inhibit autocrine EGF stimulation of tumor cells that express the EGF receptor, thereby inhibiting tumor cell proliferation.

A small molecule inhibitor of class I phosphatidylinositol 3 kinase (PI3K), with potential antineoplastic activity. Upon administration, pictilisib selectively binds to PI3K in an ATP-competitive manner, inhibiting the production of the secondary messenger phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate (PIP3) and activation of the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway. This may result in inhibition of tumor cell growth, motility and survival in susceptible tumor cell populations. Activation of the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway is frequently associated with tumorigenesis; dysregulated PI3K/Akt signaling may contribute to tumor resistance to a variety of antineoplastic agents.

A poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) -1 and -2 inhibitor with chemosensitizing and antitumor activities. With no antiproliferative effects as a single agent at therapeutic concentrations, ABT-888 inhibits PARPs, thereby inhibiting DNA repair and potentiating the cytotoxicity of DNA-damaging agents. PARP nuclear enzymes are activated by DNA single or double strand breaks, resulting in the poly(ADP-ribosyl)ation of other nuclear DNA binding proteins involved in DNA repair; poly(ADP-ribosyl)ation contributes to efficient DNA repair and to survival of proliferating cells exposed to mild genotoxic stresses as induced by as oxidants, alkylating agents or ionizing radiation.

A methylated derivative and structural analog of PRIMA-1 (p53 re-activation and induction of massive apoptosis), with potential antineoplastic activity. Upon administration, PRIMA-1 analog APR-246 covalently modifies the core domain of mutated forms of cellular tumor antigen p53 (p53) through the alkylation of thiol groups. These modifications restore both the wild-type conformation and function to mutant p53, which reconstitutes endogenous p53 activity, leading to cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in tumor cells. This agent may work synergistically with other antineoplastic agents. p53, a tumor suppressor and transcription factor normally activated upon DNA damage, is frequently mutated and overexpressed in cancer cells; it plays a key role in both DNA repair and the induction of apoptosis.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 阿扎胞苷为胞苷的嘧啶核苷类似物，具有抗肿瘤活性。 阿扎胞苷被掺入 DNA 中，它可逆地抑制 DNA 甲基转移酶，从而阻断 DNA 甲基化。 阿扎胞苷对 DNA 的低甲基化可能会激活因高甲基化而沉默的肿瘤抑制基因，从而产生抗肿瘤作用。 该试剂还掺入 RNA，从而破坏正常的 RNA 功能并削弱 tRNA 胞嘧啶-5-甲基转移酶活性。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: A pyrimidine nucleoside analogue of cytidine with antineoplastic activity. Azacitidine is incorporated into DNA, where it reversibly inhibits DNA methyltransferase, thereby blocking DNA methylation.  Hypomethylation of DNA by azacitidine may activate tumor suppressor genes silenced by hypermethylation, resulting in an antitumor effect. This agent is also incorporated into RNA, thereby disrupting normal RNA function and impairing tRNA cytosine-5-methyltransferase activity. (NCI04)

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 依维莫司是PI3K / AKT通路下游的雷帕霉素（sTOR-s苏氨酸激酶）哺乳动物靶标的抑制剂。该mTOR通路在几种人类癌症和结节性硬化复合物（TSC）中失调。细胞内蛋白FKBP-12，与mTOR复合物1（mTORC1）形成抑制性复合物，从而抑制mTOR激酶活性。依维莫司降低S6核糖体蛋白激酶（S6K1）和真核起始因子4E结合蛋白（4E -BP1），mTOR的下游效应子，参与蛋白质合成，S6K1是mTORC1的底物，磷酸化雌激素受体的激活结构域1，导致受体的配体非依赖性激活；依维莫司抑制缺氧的表达。诱导因子（例如HIF-1）并降低血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）的表达，依维莫司对mTOR的抑制作用可降低细胞增殖体外和/或体内研究中的血管生成，血管生成和葡萄糖摄取。 PI3K / Akt / mTOR途径的组成性激活可以促进乳腺癌的内分泌抵抗力。体外研究表明，雌激素依赖性和HER2 +乳腺癌细胞对依维莫司的抑制作用敏感，并且依维莫司和Akt，HER2或芳香酶抑制剂的联合治疗以协同方式增强了依维莫司的抗肿瘤活性.2 mTORC1信号的调节剂是癌基因抑制物结核菌硬化复合物1和2（TSC1，TSC2）。 TSC1或TSC2的丢失或失活导致下游信号传导的激活。在TSC中，一种遗传性疾病会导致TSC1或TSC2基因的失活突变导致错构瘤在全身的形成以及癫痫发作和癫痫发生。 mTOR的过度激活会导致神经元发育异常，轴突发生异常和树突形成，兴奋性突触电流增加，髓鞘减少以及皮质层状结构破坏。导致神经元发育和功能异常。在大脑中mTOR失调的动物模型中用mTOR抑制剂治疗可抑制癫痫发作，预防新发癫痫发作的发生并防止过早死亡。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: A derivative of the natural macrocyclic lactone sirolimus with immunosuppressant and anti-angiogenic properties. In cells, everolimus binds to the immunophilin FK Binding Protein-12 (FKBP-12) to generate an immunosuppressive complex that binds to and inhibits the activation of the mammalian Target of Rapamycin (mTOR), a key regulatory kinase. Inhibition of mTOR activation results in the inhibition of T lymphocyte activation and proliferation associated with antigen and cytokine (IL-2, IL-4, and IL-15) stimulation and the inhibition of antibody production. (NCI05)

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 贝伐珠单抗结合VEGF并阻止VEGF与其在内皮细胞表面的受体（Flt-1和KDR）相互作用。 在血管生成的体外模型中，VEGF与其受体的相互作用导致内皮细胞增殖和新血管形成。 在裸鼠结肠癌异种移植模型中应用贝伐珠单抗可降低微血管生长和抑制转移性疾病的进展。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: A recombinant humanized monoclonal antibody directed against the vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), a pro-angiogenic cytokine.  Bevacizumab binds to VEGF and inhibits VEGF receptor binding, thereby preventing the growth and maintenance of tumor blood vessels.

adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带有害或疑似有害BRCA胚系变异（gBRCAm）的前线经3线及以上化疗的晚期卵巢癌成人患者的治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带BRCA胚系突变（gBRCAm）的HER2阴性的转移性乳腺癌成人患者，这些患者既往接受过新辅助、辅助或转移性治疗中接受过化疗；HR阳性的乳腺癌患者应接受过内分泌治疗或被认为不适合进行内分泌治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带胚系或体细胞 BRCA 突变、一线基于铂类化疗完全缓解或部分缓解的晚期上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成人患者的维持治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带有害或疑似有害BRCA胚系突变的（gBRCAm）、接受一线铂类化疗至少16周无进展的转移性胰腺腺癌成人患者的治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带有害或疑似有害的HRR基因胚系或体细胞突变的（ATMm、BRCA1m、BRCA2m、BARD1m、BRIP1m、CDK12m、CHEK1m、CHEK2m、FANCLm、PALB2m、RAD51Bm、 RAD51Cm、RAD51Dm、RAD54Lm）、前线经恩杂鲁胺或阿比特龙治疗的转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌成人患者（mCRPC）的治疗。
NMPA批准奥拉帕利适用于携带胚系或体细胞BRCA突变的（gBRCAm或sBRCAm）晚期上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成人患者在一线含铂化疗达到完全缓解或部分缓解后的维持治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利适用于携带有害或疑似有害胚系变异（gBRCAm）的、HER2阴性、高风险早期乳腺癌成人患者的辅助治疗，这些患者既往接受过新辅助或辅助化疗。
NMPA批准奥拉帕利用于铂敏感的复发性上皮性卵巢癌或输卵管癌、原发性腹膜癌成人患者在含铂化疗达到完全缓解或部分缓解后的维持治疗。
FDA批准奥拉帕利用于携带胚系或体细胞 BRCA 突变、基于铂类化疗完全缓解或部分缓解的晚期上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成人患者的维持治疗。
NMPA附条件批准奥拉帕利单药用于携带胚系或体细胞BRCA突变（gBRCAm或sBRCAm）且既往治疗（包括一种新型内分泌药物）失败的转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌成人患者的治疗。
EMA批准奥拉帕利用于成人晚期（FIGO III期和IV期）BRCA1/2突变（胚系和/或体细胞）高级别上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌患者的维持治疗，且患者在完成一线铂类化疗后达到缓解（完全缓解或部分缓解）。
EMA批准奥拉帕利单药或联合内分泌治疗，用于既往接受过新辅助或辅助化疗的成年患者中，携带胚系BRCA1/2突变（gBRCAm）、HER2阴性的高危早期乳腺癌的辅助治疗。
EMA批准奥拉帕利用于携带胚系BRCA1/2突变（gBRCA1/2）、HER2阴性的局部晚期或转移性乳腺癌成年患者的治疗。患者既往应接受过蒽环类和紫杉烷类药物治疗，治疗可在（新）辅助或转移性疾病阶段进行；如果患者不适合接受上述治疗，则可例外。对于激素受体（HR）阳性乳腺癌患者，还应在既往内分泌治疗期间或治疗后出现疾病进展，或被认为不适合接受内分泌治疗。
EMA批准奥拉帕利用于成人携带胚系BRCA1/2突变、患有转移性胰腺腺癌且在一线化疗方案中接受至少16周含铂治疗后未发生疾病进展患者的维持治疗。
EMA批准奥拉帕利用于既往接受过包含新型激素药物（NHA）治疗且疾病进展的、携带BRCA1/2突变（胚系和/或体细胞）的成人转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌（mCRPC）患者的治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: FDA approved Olaparib for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline BRCA-mutated (gBRCAm) advanced ovarian cancer who have been treated with three or more prior lines of chemotherapy.

FDA approved Olaparib for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious gBRCAm, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer who have 
been treated with chemotherapy in the neoadjuvant, adjuvant or metastatic setting. Patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive breast cancer should have been treated with a prior endocrine therapy or be considered inappropriate for endocrine therapy.

FDA approved Olaparib for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline or somatic BRCA-mutated advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer who are in complete or partial response to first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.

FDA approved Olaparib for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious gBRCAm metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma whose disease has not progressed on at least 16 weeks of a first-line platinum-based chemotherapy regimen.

FDA approved Olaparib for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline or somatic homologous recombination repair (HRR) gene-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) who have progressed following prior treatment with enzalutamide or abiraterone.

FDA approved Olaparib for the adjuvant treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious gBRCAm human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative high risk early breast cancer who have been treated with neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy.

FDA approved Olaparib for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline or somatic BRCA-mutated recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer, who are in complete or partial response to platinum-based chemotherapy.

EMA approved olaparib for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with advanced (FIGO stages III and IV) BRCA1/2-mutated (germline and/or somatic) high-grade epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who are in response (complete or partial) following completion of first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.

EMA approved olaparib, as monotherapy or in combination with endocrine therapy for the adjuvant treatment of adult patients with germline BRCA1/2-mutated (gBRCAm), HER2-negative, high-risk early breast cancer who have previously received neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy.

EMA approved olaparib for the treatment of adult patients with germline BRCA1/2-mutations, who have HER2 negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. Patients should have previously been treated with an anthracycline and a taxane in the (neo)adjuvant or metastatic setting unless patients were not suitable for these treatments (see section 5.1). Patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive breast cancer should also have progressed on or after prior endocrine therapy, or be considered unsuitable for endocrine therapy.

EMA approved olaparib for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with germline BRCA1/2-mutations who have metastatic adenocarcinoma of the pancreas and have not progressed after a minimum of 16 weeks of platinum treatment within a first-line chemotherapy regimen.

EMA approved olaparib as monotherapy for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) and BRCA1/2-mutations (germline and/or somatic) who have progressed following prior therapy that included a new hormonal agent.
approval_tumour: 卵巢/输卵管癌;Ovarian/Fallopian Tube Cancer

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: Olaparib（Lynparza）是聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）酶的抑制剂，包括PARP1，PARP2和PARP3。 PARP酶参与正常的细胞功能，例如DNA转录和DNA修复。 已经证明Olaparib在体外抑制人类肿瘤小鼠异种移植模型中特定肿瘤细胞系的生长，无论是单一疗法还是铂类化学疗法。 在细胞株和小鼠肿瘤模型中发现，用olaparib治疗后细胞毒性和抗肿瘤活性增加，而BRCA和非BRCA蛋白的缺陷与DNA损伤的同源重组修复（HRR）有关，并与铂反应相关。 体外研究表明，Olaparib诱导的细胞毒性可能涉及抑制PARP酶活性和增加PARP-DNA复合物的形成，从而导致细胞稳态的破坏和细胞死亡。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: A small molecule inhibitor of the nuclear enzyme poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) with potential chemosensitizing, radiosensitizing, and antineoplastic activities. Olaparib selectively binds to and inhibits PARP, inhibiting PARP-mediated repair of single strand DNA breaks; PARP inhibition may enhance the cytotoxicity of DNA-damaging agents and may reverse tumor cell chemoresistance and radioresistance. PARP catalyzes post-translational ADP-ribosylation of nuclear proteins and can be activated by single-stranded DNA breaks.

adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准鲁卡帕尼用于携带BRCA胚系或体系有害突变的、接受过雄激素受体的治疗及基于紫杉醇的方案化疗的转移性去势抵抗前列腺癌（mCRPC）成人患者的治疗。
FDA批准鲁卡帕尼用于对铂类化疗完全或部分反应的复发性上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成年患者的维持治疗。
FDA批准鲁卡帕尼用于携带有害BRCA突变（胚系和/或体细胞）、对铂类化疗完全或部分缓解的复发性上皮性卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌成年患者的维持治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: FDA approved Rucaparib for the treatment of adult patients with a deleterious BRCA mutation (germline and/or somatic)-associated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) who have been treated with androgen receptor-directed therapy and a taxane-based chemotherapy.

FDA approved RUBRACA for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with a deleterious BRCA mutation (germline and/or somatic)- associated recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who are in a complete or partial response to platinum-based chemotherapy.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: Rucaparib是一种多聚(adp -核糖)聚合酶(PARP)的抑制剂，包括PARP-1, PARP-2和PARP-3，在DNA修复中发挥作用。体外研究表明，rucaparib诱导的细胞毒性可能会抑制PARP酶活性和促进PARP-DNA复合物的形成，从而导致DNA损伤、细胞凋亡和癌细胞死亡。在BRCA1/2和其他DNA修复基因缺失的肿瘤细胞系中观察到rucaparib诱导的细胞毒性和抗肿瘤活性增加。Rucaparib已被证明在人类癌症的小鼠异种移植模型中降低肿瘤生长，无论是否存在BRCA缺失。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: An orally bioavailable tricyclic indole and inhibitor of poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases (PARPs) 1 (PARP1), 2 (PARP2) and 3 (PARP3), with potential chemo/radiosensitizing and antineoplastic activities. Upon administration, rucaparib selectively binds to PARP1, 2 and 3 and inhibits PARP-mediated DNA repair. This enhances the accumulation of DNA strand breaks, promotes genomic instability and induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis. This may enhance the cytotoxicity of DNA-damaging agents and reverse tumor cell resistance to chemotherapy and radiation therapy. PARPs are enzymes activated by single-strand DNA breaks that catalyze the post-translational ADP-ribosylation of nuclear proteins, which induces signaling and the recruitment of other proteins to repair damaged DNA. The PARP-mediated repair pathway plays a key role in DNA repair and is dysregulated in a variety of cancer cell types.

adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准贝伐珠单抗用于治疗复发性胶质母细胞瘤成人患者。
NMPA批准贝伐珠单抗用于成人复发性胶质母细胞瘤患者的治疗。
EMA批准阿瓦斯汀（Avastin，贝伐珠单抗）与静脉注射的 5-氟尿嘧啶/亚叶酸钙或静脉注射的 5-氟尿嘧啶/亚叶酸钙/伊立替康联合使用，适用于转移性结肠癌或直肠癌患者的一线治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: The EMA has approved the use of Avastin (bevacizumab) in combination with intravenous 5-fluorouracil/leucovorin or intravenous 5-fluorouracil/leucovorin/irinotecan for the first-line treatment of patients with metastatic colon cancer or rectal cancer.
approval_tumour: 非小细胞肺癌;Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 贝伐珠单抗结合VEGF并阻止VEGF与其在内皮细胞表面的受体（Flt-1和KDR）相互作用。 在血管生成的体外模型中，VEGF与其受体的相互作用导致内皮细胞增殖和新血管形成。 在裸鼠结肠癌异种移植模型中应用贝伐珠单抗可降低微血管生长和抑制转移性疾病的进展。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: A recombinant humanized monoclonal antibody directed against the vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), a pro-angiogenic cytokine.  Bevacizumab binds to VEGF and inhibits VEGF receptor binding, thereby preventing the growth and maintenance of tumor blood vessels.

A small molecule inhibitor of the tyrosine kinase WEE1 with potential antineoplastic sensitizing activity. Adavosertib selectively targets and inhibits WEE1, a tyrosine kinase that phosphorylates cyclin-dependent kinase 1 (CDK1, CDC2) to inactivate the CDC2/cyclin B complex. Inhibition of WEE1 activity prevents the phosphorylation of CDC2 and impairs the G2 DNA damage checkpoint. This may lead to apoptosis upon treatment with DNA damaging chemotherapeutic agents. Unlike normal cells, most p53 deficient or mutated human cancers lack the G1 checkpoint as p53 is the key regulator of the G1 checkpoint and these cells rely on the G2 checkpoint for DNA repair to damaged cells. Annulment of the G2 checkpoint may therefore make p53 deficient tumor cells more vulnerable to antineoplastic agents and enhance their cytotoxic effect.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 紫杉醇是一种抗微管类的化疗药物。 紫杉醇常用于多种癌症治疗中，它是一种有丝分裂抑制剂，是于 1971 年从太平洋紫杉树的树皮中首次分离出来，并于1993年批准用于医学用途，并被列于世界卫生组织的基本药物清单。 紫杉醇的作用机理主要是去影响微管的正常功能，透过稳定与GDP结合的微管蛋白，从而致使快速分裂的肿瘤细胞在有丝分裂阶段被限制而无法分离，将细胞阻断于细胞周期之G2与M期间，使癌细胞复制受阻断而死亡。因此紫杉醇在抗癌药物当中，被视为有丝分裂中的微管抑制剂。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: Paclitaxel is a chemotherapeutic agent marketed under the brand name Taxol among others. Used as a treatment for various cancers, paclitaxel is a mitotic inhibitor that was first isolated in 1971 from the bark of the Pacific yew tree which contains endophytic fungi that synthesize paclitaxel. It is available as an intravenous solution for injection and the newer formulation contains albumin-bound paclitaxel marketed under the brand name Abraxane.

adaptation_disease_cn: NMPA批准瑞戈非尼用于治疗既往接受过以氟尿嘧啶、奥沙利铂和伊立替康为基础的化疗, 以及既往接受过或不适合接受抗VEGF治疗、抗EGFR治疗（RAS野生型）的转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）患者。
FDA批准瑞戈非尼用于治疗既往接受过以氟尿嘧啶、奥沙利铂和伊立替康为基础的化疗, 以及抗VEGF治疗、抗EGFR治疗（KRAS野生型）的转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）患者。
FDA批准瑞戈非尼用于既往接受过甲磺酸伊马替尼及苹果酸舒尼替尼治疗的局部晚期、不可切除或转移性胃肠道间质瘤患者。
FDA批准瑞戈非尼用于既往接受过索拉非尼治疗的肝细胞癌（HCC）患者。

NMPA批准瑞戈非尼用于治疗既往接受过甲磺酸伊马替尼及苹果酸舒尼替尼治疗的局部晚期的、无法手术切除的或转移性的胃肠道间质瘤（GIST）患者。
NMPA批准瑞戈非尼用于治疗既往接受过索拉非尼治疗的肝细胞癌（HCC）患者。
adaptation_disease_en: Regorafenib is indicated for the treatment of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC) who have been previously treated with fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin- and irinotecan-based chemotherapy, an anti-VEGF therapy, and, if KRAS wild type, an anti-EGFR therapy.

Regorafenib is indicated for the treatment of patients with locally advanced, unresectable or metastatic gastrointestinal stromal tumour (GIST) who have been previously treated with imatinib mesylate and sunitinib malate.
Regorafenib is indicated for the treatment of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) previously treated with sorafenib.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: Regorafenib（瑞格菲尼）是多种与细胞膜结合的胞内激酶的小分子抑制剂，参与正常的细胞功能以及病理过程，例如肿瘤发生，肿瘤血管生成，转移和肿瘤免疫。 在体外生化或细胞分析中，在临床上已达到的Regorafenib浓度下，Regorafenib或其主要人类活性代谢产物M-2和M-5抑制RET，VEGFR1，VEGFR2，VEGFR3，KIT，PDGFR-alpha，PDGFR-beta，FGFR1，FGFR2，TIE2， DDR2，TrkA，Eph2A，RAF-1，BRAF，BRAF V600E，SAPK2，PTK5，Abl和CSF1R的活性。 在体内模型中，Regorafenib在大鼠肿瘤模型中显示出抗血管生成活性，并在几种小鼠异种移植模型中显示出对肿瘤生长的抑制作用，其中包括对人结肠直肠癌，胃肠道间质癌和肝细胞癌的某些模型。 Regorafenib还在人大肠癌的小鼠异种移植模型和两个原位小鼠模型中显示出抗转移活性。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: An orally bioavailable small molecule with potential antiangiogenic and antineoplastic activities. Regorafenib binds to and inhibits vascular endothelial growth factor receptors (VEGFRs) 2 and 3, and Ret, Kit, PDGFR and Raf kinases, which may result in the inhibition of tumor angiogenesis and tumor cell proliferation. VEGFRs are receptor tyrosine kinases that play important roles in tumor angiogenesis; the receptor tyrosine kinases RET, KIT, and PDGFR, and the serine/threonine-specific Raf kinase are involved in tumor cell signaling.

A small molecule inhibitor of the tyrosine kinase WEE1 with potential antineoplastic sensitizing activity. Adavosertib selectively targets and inhibits WEE1, a tyrosine kinase that phosphorylates cyclin-dependent kinase 1 (CDK1, CDC2) to inactivate the CDC2/cyclin B complex. Inhibition of WEE1 activity prevents the phosphorylation of CDC2 and impairs the G2 DNA damage checkpoint. This may lead to apoptosis upon treatment with DNA damaging chemotherapeutic agents. Unlike normal cells, most p53 deficient or mutated human cancers lack the G1 checkpoint as p53 is the key regulator of the G1 checkpoint and these cells rely on the G2 checkpoint for DNA repair to damaged cells. Annulment of the G2 checkpoint may therefore make p53 deficient tumor cells more vulnerable to antineoplastic agents and enhance their cytotoxic effect.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 卡铂的主要作用是将烷基连接到核苷酸上，导致单加合物的形成，以及当修复酶试图纠正错误时 DNA 片段化。 2% 的卡铂活性来自 DNA 从一条链上的碱基到另一条上碱基的交联，从而防止 DNA 链分离以进行合成或转录。卡铂可以诱导许多不同的突变。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: Carboplatin is an organoplatinum antineoplastic alkylating agent used in the treatment of advanced ovarian carcinoma.Early clinical studies of carboplatin were performed in 1982. Carboplatin was developed as an analog of cisplatin with reduced nephrotoxicity and vomiting.Carboplatin was granted FDA approval on 3 March 1989.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 紫杉醇是一种抗微管类的化疗药物。 紫杉醇常用于多种癌症治疗中，它是一种有丝分裂抑制剂，是于 1971 年从太平洋紫杉树的树皮中首次分离出来，并于1993年批准用于医学用途，并被列于世界卫生组织的基本药物清单。 紫杉醇的作用机理主要是去影响微管的正常功能，透过稳定与GDP结合的微管蛋白，从而致使快速分裂的肿瘤细胞在有丝分裂阶段被限制而无法分离，将细胞阻断于细胞周期之G2与M期间，使癌细胞复制受阻断而死亡。因此紫杉醇在抗癌药物当中，被视为有丝分裂中的微管抑制剂。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: Paclitaxel is a chemotherapeutic agent marketed under the brand name Taxol among others. Used as a treatment for various cancers, paclitaxel is a mitotic inhibitor that was first isolated in 1971 from the bark of the Pacific yew tree which contains endophytic fungi that synthesize paclitaxel. It is available as an intravenous solution for injection and the newer formulation contains albumin-bound paclitaxel marketed under the brand name Abraxane.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: NXP800是一种口服生物可以利用的HSF1通路抑制剂。口服后，NXP800可靶向并抑制HSF1调节通路的活性，阻止HSF1介导的转录，可抑制肿瘤细胞的增殖、迁移、存活和转移，特别是存在ARID1A突变的肿瘤细胞。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: An orally bioavailable fluorobisamide and heat shock factor 1 (HSF1) pathway inhibitor, with potential antineoplastic activity. Upon oral administration, HSF1 pathway inhibitor NXP800 targets and inhibits the activity of the HSF1-regulated pathway, thereby preventing HSF1-mediated transcription. This inhibits proliferation, migration, survival, and metastasis in susceptible tumor cells, especially in AT-rich interaction domain 1A (ARID1A)-mutated cancer cells. HSF1, a stress-inducible transcription factor that plays a key role in the transcriptional activation of the eukaryotic heat shock response; its activation leads to expression of many heat shock proteins (HSPs). Overexpressed, amplified and/or overactivated in many cancer cells, HSF1 activates a set of genes that play a key role in tumor initiation, progression and metastasis.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 卡铂的主要作用是将烷基连接到核苷酸上，导致单加合物的形成，以及当修复酶试图纠正错误时 DNA 片段化。 2% 的卡铂活性来自 DNA 从一条链上的碱基到另一条上碱基的交联，从而防止 DNA 链分离以进行合成或转录。卡铂可以诱导许多不同的突变。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: Carboplatin is an organoplatinum antineoplastic alkylating agent used in the treatment of advanced ovarian carcinoma.Early clinical studies of carboplatin were performed in 1982. Carboplatin was developed as an analog of cisplatin with reduced nephrotoxicity and vomiting.Carboplatin was granted FDA approval on 3 March 1989.

A small molecule inhibitor of the tyrosine kinase WEE1 with potential antineoplastic sensitizing activity. Adavosertib selectively targets and inhibits WEE1, a tyrosine kinase that phosphorylates cyclin-dependent kinase 1 (CDK1, CDC2) to inactivate the CDC2/cyclin B complex. Inhibition of WEE1 activity prevents the phosphorylation of CDC2 and impairs the G2 DNA damage checkpoint. This may lead to apoptosis upon treatment with DNA damaging chemotherapeutic agents. Unlike normal cells, most p53 deficient or mutated human cancers lack the G1 checkpoint as p53 is the key regulator of the G1 checkpoint and these cells rely on the G2 checkpoint for DNA repair to damaged cells. Annulment of the G2 checkpoint may therefore make p53 deficient tumor cells more vulnerable to antineoplastic agents and enhance their cytotoxic effect.

A small molecule inhibitor of class I phosphatidylinositol 3 kinase (PI3K), with potential antineoplastic activity. Upon administration, pictilisib selectively binds to PI3K in an ATP-competitive manner, inhibiting the production of the secondary messenger phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate (PIP3) and activation of the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway. This may result in inhibition of tumor cell growth, motility and survival in susceptible tumor cell populations. Activation of the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway is frequently associated with tumorigenesis; dysregulated PI3K/Akt signaling may contribute to tumor resistance to a variety of antineoplastic agents.

adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准他拉唑帕利用于携带BRCA胚系有害或疑似有害突变（gBRCAm）的HER2阴性的局部晚期或转移性乳腺癌成人患者的治疗。
EMA批准他拉唑帕利适用于作为单药治疗，用于治疗携带胚系BRCA1/2突变、HER2阴性的局部晚期或转移性乳腺癌成人患者。患者此前应在（新辅助）辅助治疗、局部晚期或转移性治疗阶段接受过蒽环类和/或紫杉类药物治疗，除非患者不适合接受此类治疗。激素受体（HR）阳性乳腺癌患者应曾接受过内分泌治疗，或被认为不适合接受内分泌治疗。
adaptation_disease_en: FDA approved Talazoparib for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline BRCA-mutated (gBRCAm) HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.

EMA has approved talazoparib for use as monotherapy for the treatment of adult patients with germline BRCA1/2-mutations, who have HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. Patients should have been previously treated with an anthracycline and/or a taxane in the (neo)adjuvant, locally advanced or metastatic setting unless patients were not suitable for these treatments. Patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive breast cancer should have been treated with a prior endocrine-based therapy, or be considered unsuitable for endocrine-based therapy.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 他拉唑帕利是一种聚腺苷二磷酸核糖聚合酶（PARP，包括PARP1和PARP2）抑制剂，该酶在 DNA 修复中发挥作用。携带DNA修复基因（包括BRCA1和BRCA2）缺陷的癌细胞系的体外试验显示，他拉唑帕利诱导的细胞毒性可能涉及抑制PARP酶活性和增加PARP-DNA复合物的形成，从而导致DNA损伤、细胞增殖减少和细胞凋亡。他拉唑帕利在携带突变型BRCA1和BRCA2或野生型BRCA1和BRCA2的患者来源的乳腺癌异种移植瘤模型中可见抗肿瘤活性。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: An orally bioavailable inhibitor of the nuclear enzyme poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) with potential antineoplastic activity. Talazoparib selectively binds to PARP and prevents PARP-mediated DNA repair of single strand DNA breaks via the base-excision repair pathway. This enhances the accumulation of DNA strand breaks, promotes genomic instability and eventually leads to apoptosis. PARP catalyzes post-translational ADP-ribosylation of nuclear proteins that signal and recruit other proteins to repair damaged DNA and is activated by single-strand DNA breaks.

adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准西妥昔单抗单药用于奥沙利铂和伊立替康为基础的化疗失败或对伊立替康不耐受的K-Ras 野生型、EGFR 表达的转移性结直肠癌患者的治疗。
FDA批准西妥昔单抗用于铂类治疗后进展的复发或转移性头颈部鳞状细胞癌患者。

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 表皮生长因子受体（EGFR，HER1，c-ErbB-1）是跨膜糖蛋白，是I型受体酪氨酸激酶（包括EGFR，HER2，HER3和HER4）亚族成员之一。 EGFR在包括皮肤和毛囊在内的许多正常上皮组织中组成性表达。EGFR的表达在多种人类癌症（包括头颈部癌、结肠和直肠癌）中同样被检出。西妥昔单抗与正常和肿瘤细胞上的EGFR特异性结合，并竞争性抑制表皮生长因子（EGF）和其他配体（如转化生长因子-α）的结合。体外试验和体内动物研究表明，西妥昔单抗与EGFR的结合可阻断受体相关激酶的磷酸化和激活，从而抑制细胞生长，诱导细胞凋亡，并降低基质金属蛋白酶和血管内皮生长因子的产生。EGFR信号转导可导致野生型Ras蛋白的激活，但是在具有激活性Ras体细胞突变的细胞中，突变Ras蛋白都表现出持续的活性，不受EGFR调控状态的影响。在体外，西妥昔单抗可调节针对部分类型人类肿瘤的抗体依赖性细胞毒性（ADCC）。体外试验和体内动物研究表明，西妥昔单抗可抑制EGFR表达肿瘤细胞的生长和存活。在缺乏EGFR表达的人源肿瘤异种移植体中未观察到西妥昔单抗的抗肿瘤作用。在人源肿瘤异种移植小鼠模型中，西妥昔单抗加放疗或西妥昔单抗加伊立替康的抗肿瘤效果强于单独的放疗或化疗。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: A recombinant, chimeric monoclonal antibody directed against the epidermal growth factor (EGFR) with antineoplastic activity. Cetuximab binds to the extracellular domain of the EGFR, thereby preventing the activation and subsequent dimerization of the receptor; the decrease in receptor activation and dimerization may result in an inhibition in signal transduction and anti-proliferative effects. This agent may inhibit EGFR-dependent primary tumor growth and metastasis. EGFR is overexpressed on the cell surfaces of various solid tumors.

adaptation_disease_cn: NMPA批准西妥昔单抗β与FOLFIRI方案联合用于一线治疗RAS/BRAF基因野生型的转移性结直肠癌。

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: CMAB009（西妥昔单抗β）是一种专门靶向人表皮生长因子受体 （EGFR） 的重组人/小鼠嵌合单克隆抗体 （mAb），竞争性抑制配体结合和相互关联的下游信号传导。它具有与 ERBITUX （西妥昔单抗） 相同的氨基酸序列，但糖基化和其他翻译后修饰 （PTM） 的能力略有不同。CMAB009 由中国仓鼠卵巢 （CHO） 细胞表达，而西妥昔单抗由小鼠细胞系 SP2/0 表达，该细胞系也表达 α-1,3-半乳糖基转移酶基因。在大多数对西妥昔单抗产生超敏反应的患者中，发现在治疗开始前他们的血清中已经存在针对西妥昔单抗的 IgE 抗体。发现这些抗体对半乳糖-α-1,3-半乳糖 （Gal （α 1-3） Gal） 具有特异性。由于 CHO 细胞不产生 α-1,3-半乳糖基转移酶，因此它们具有与 SP2/0 不同的糖基化模式，因此，在 CHO 细胞中表达的 CMAB009 具有较低水平的含 Gal （α 1-3） Gal 聚糖。这表明与西妥昔单抗相比，CMAB009可能具有较低的免疫原性和较少的超敏反应。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: CMAB009, a recombinant, human/mouse chimeric monoclonal antibody (mAb) specifically targeting the human epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), competitively inhibits ligand-binding and interrelated downstream signaling.  It has the same amino acid sequence as ERBITUX (cetuximab), but slightly different abilities for glycosylation and other post-translational modifications (PTMs).  CMAB009 is expressed by the Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells while cetuximab is expressed by the mouse cell line SP2/0 which also expresses the gene for α-1,3-galactosyltransferase [®14].  In most patients who have developed a hypersensitivity reaction to cetuximab, IgE antibodies against the cetuximab were found to be already present in their serum prior to the start of the therapy .  These antibodies were found to be specific for galactose-α-1,3-galactose (Gal (α 1-3) Gal).  Since CHO cells do not produce α-1,3-galactosyltransferase, they have a pattern of glycosylation that differs from that of SP2/0 , as such, CMAB009 expressed in CHO cells has a lower level of Gal (α 1-3) Gal-containing glycans.  This suggests that CMAB009 might have lower immunogenicity and reduced hypersensitivity reactions as compared to cetuximab.

adaptation_disease_cn: NMPA已经批准呋喹替尼单药适用于既往接受过氟尿嘧啶类、奥沙利铂和伊立替康为基础的化疗，以及既往接受过或不适合接受抗血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）治疗、抗表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）治疗（RAS野生型）的转移性结直肠癌（mCRC）患者。
FDA批准呋喹替尼用于治疗既往接受过氟尿嘧啶、奥沙利铂和伊立替康为基础化疗，抗VEGF治疗、抗EGFR治疗（RAS野生型）的转移性结直肠癌成年患者。

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 呋喹替尼是一具有高度选择性的肿瘤血管生成抑制剂，其主要作用靶点是VEGFR激酶家族VEGFR1， 2及3。呋喹替尼在分子水平可抑制VEGFR激酶的活性；在细胞水平上可抑制VEGFR2/3的磷酸化，抑制内皮细胞的增殖及管腔形成；在组织水平上，呋喹替尼可明显抑制鸡胚绒毛尿囊膜模型新生微血管的形成；在整体动物水平上，呋喹替尼口服后可抑制VEGFR2/3磷酸化，抑制肿瘤血管生成，从而抑制肿瘤生长。在整体动物上，呋喹替尼采用一日一次给药，对结直肠癌以及其它多种类型肿瘤模型的生长均显示强效且剂量依赖性的抑制效应，在敏感模型上发现肿瘤缩小和消退。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: An orally available, small molecule inhibitor of vascular endothelial growth factor receptors (VEGFRs), with potential anti-angiogenic and antineoplastic activities. Upon oral administration, fruquintinib inhibits VEGF-induced phosphorylation of VEGFRs 1, 2, and 3 which may result in the inhibition of migration, proliferation and survival of endothelial cells, microvessel formation, the inhibition of tumor cell proliferation, and tumor cell death. Expression of VEGFRs may be upregulated in a variety of tumor cell types.

adaptation_disease_cn: FDA批准达沙替尼(dasatinib)用于治疗新确诊的费城染色体阳性（Ph+）慢性粒细胞白血病（CML）成年患者。

FDA批准达沙替尼(dasatinib)联合化疗用于治疗1岁及以上新确诊为费城染色体阳性（Ph+）的急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）的儿科患者。
FDA批准达沙替尼(dasatinib)用于治疗对其他疗法无效或不能耐受的费城染色体阳性（Ph+）的急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）成年患者。

FDA批准达沙替尼(dasatinib)用于治疗1岁及以上慢性期费城染色体阳性（Ph+）慢性粒细胞白血病（CML）的儿科患者。
FDA批准达沙替尼(dasatinib)用于治疗对伊马替尼等一线药物化疗不敏感的各期费城染色体阳性（Ph+）慢性粒细胞白血病（CML）成年患者。

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 根据建模研究，预测达沙替尼可与ABL激酶的多种构象结合。 在甲磺酸伊马替尼敏感和耐药型的白血病细胞系中，达沙替尼均表现出体外活性。 达沙替尼可抑制过表达BCR-ABL的慢性粒细胞白血病（CML）和急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）细胞的生长。 达沙替尼可克服因BCR-ABL激酶结构域突变、SRC家族激酶（LYN，HCK）的旁信号通路的激活以及多药耐药基因过表达而引起的伊马替尼耐药性。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: An orally bioavailable synthetic small molecule-inhibitor of SRC-family protein-tyrosine kinases.  Dasatinib binds to and inhibits the growth-promoting activities of these kinases. Apparently because of its less stringent binding affinity for the BCR-ABL kinase, dasatinib has been shown to overcome the resistance to imatinib of chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) cells harboring BCR-ABL kinase domain point mutations. SRC-family protein-tyrosine kinases interact with a variety of cell-surface receptors and participate in intracellular signal transduction pathways; tumorigenic forms can occur through altered regulation or expression of the endogenous protein and by way of virally-encoded kinase genes.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: Pazopanib（帕唑帕尼）是一种多酪氨酸激酶抑制剂，包括血管内皮生长因子受体（VEGFR）-1，VEGFR-2，VEGFR-3，血小板衍生生长因子受体（PDGFR）-α和-β，成纤维细胞生长因子受体（FGFR） -1和-3，细胞因子受体（Kit），白介素2受体诱导的T细胞激酶（Itk），淋巴细胞特异性蛋白酪氨酸激酶（Lck）和跨膜糖蛋白受体酪氨酸激酶（c-Fms）。 在体外，Pazopanib抑制配体诱导的VEGFR-2，Kit和PDGFR-β受体的自磷酸化。 在体内，Pazopanib抑制小鼠肺中VEGF诱导的VEGFR-2磷酸化，小鼠模型中的血管生成以及小鼠中某些人肿瘤异种移植物的生长。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: A small molecule inhibitor of multiple protein tyrosine kinases with potential antineoplastic activity. Pazopanib selectively inhibits vascular endothelial growth factor receptors (VEGFR)-1, -2 and -3, c-kit and platelet derived growth factor receptor (PDGF-R), which may result in inhibition of angiogenesis in tumors in which these receptors are upregulated.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn: 伏立诺他可通过nM级别的浓度（IC50＜86nM）抑制I型组蛋白去乙酰酶IHDAC1/HDAC2/HDAC3和II型的HDAC6的酶活。这些酶能够去除包括组蛋白和转录因子等蛋白中赖氨酸残疾上的乙酰基团。在一些肿瘤中，过表达HDAC或招募至转录因子的HDAC水平异常可导致核小体组蛋白低乙酰化，组蛋白低乙酰化与染色质结构压缩和基因转录受抑制相关。抑制HDAC活性可使乙酰基团在组蛋白赖氨酸残基中积累以便有开放的染色质结构和正常的转录活性。在体外实验中，伏立诺地证实可导致一些转化细胞中的乙酰化的组蛋白积累并诱导细胞周期阻滞和/或凋亡。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: A synthetic hydroxamic acid derivative with antineoplastic activity. Vorinostat, a second generation polar-planar compound, binds to the catalytic domain of the histone deacetylases (HDACs). This allows the hydroxamic moiety to chelate zinc ion located in the catalytic pockets of HDAC, thereby inhibiting deacetylation and leading to an accumulation of both hyperacetylated histones and transcription factors. Hyperacetylation of histone proteins results in the upregulation of the cyclin-dependant kinase p21, followed by G1 arrest. Hyperacetylation of non-histone proteins such as tumor suppressor p53, alpha tubulin, and heat-shock protein 90 produces additional anti-proliferative effects. This agent also induces apoptosis and sensitizes tumor cells to cell death processes. Vorinostat crosses the blood-brain barrier.

drug_details.drug_mechanism_cn:
Alpelisib是磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（PI3K）的抑制剂，主要具有针对PI3Kα的抑制活性。在体外和体内模型中，编码PI3K的催化性α-亚基（PIK3CA）的基因中的功能获得性突变导致PI3Kα的激活和Akt信号转导，细胞转化以及肿瘤的产生。
在乳腺癌细胞系中，alpelisib抑制PI3K下游靶标（包括Akt）的磷酸化，并在具有PIK3CA突变的细胞系中显示活性。在体内，alpelisib在异种移植模型（包括乳腺癌模型）中抑制PI3K / Akt信号传导途径并减少肿瘤生长。
通过alpelisib治疗抑制PI3K已显示可诱导乳腺癌细胞中雌激素受体（ER）转录增加。与单独的两种治疗方法相比，alpelisib和fulvestrant的组合具有增强的抗肿瘤活性，而这两种方法均来自ER阳性，PIK3CA突变的乳腺癌细胞系。
drug_details.drug_mechanism_en: An orally bioavailable phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K) inhibitor with potential antineoplastic activity. Alpelisib specifically inhibits PI3K in the PI3K/AKT kinase (or protein kinase B) signaling pathway, thereby inhibiting the activation of the PI3K signaling pathway. This may result in inhibition of tumor cell growth and survival in susceptible tumor cell populations. Activation of the PI3K signaling pathway is frequently associated with tumorigenesis. Dysregulated PI3K signaling may contribute to tumor resistance to a variety of antineoplastic agents.

p_var.variant_interpret_en: This variant is expected to form functionally impaired or inactive proteins. p_var.variant_desc_cn: 该变异为移码突变，导致基因编码蛋白第37位氨基酸由甘氨酸突变为丙氨酸并于50位发生终止。
p_var.variant_desc_en: This variant is a frameshift mutation, which induces a substitution of Glycine with Alanine at position 37 and causes termination of the protein at codon 50.

evi_sum.evi_interpretation: 一项回顾性研究中（PMID: 32111729），分析了3403位病人的数据，这些患者的肿瘤组织均有二代测序数据。在9个ARID1A发生率大于5%的癌种中，与ARID1A野生型的患者相比，ARID1A突变的患者中具有MSI-H和TMB-H的比例显著更高（20% vs 0.9%, p<0.001;26% vs 8.4%, p<0.001）。在接受检查点阻断免疫疗法后，ARID1A突变的患者（n=46）的中位PFS显著高于ARID1A野生型的患者（n=329）（11个月 vs 4个月，p=0.006），且该结果独立于MSI或TMB；另外，ARID1A突变患者的中位OS也显著高于野生型患者（31个月 vs 20个月），但是没有统计学差异。

一项II期临床试验（PMID: 32975815），入组39位肾细胞癌患者，其中乳头状特征的未分类肾细胞癌（uRCC）患者24例，乳头状肾细胞癌（pRCC）患者14例，乳头状特征的转座相关的RCC患者1例。在结果可评估的37位患者中，6个月PFS为78%，中位PFS为13.7个月，ORR为35%；中位随访17.6个月，中位OS为33.9个月。对其中33位患者进行NGS测序，发现ARID1A、FH、MET突变的患者具有响应。其中，100%的ARID1A患者（7/7）、91%的FH突变患者（10/11）达到6个月的无进展生存；57%的ARID1A突变患者和55%的FH突变患者有客观缓解。

一项首次人体、开放标签的I/II期临床试验（NCT04104776），旨在评估Tulmimetostat在晚期实体瘤和淋巴瘤患者中的疗效和安全性。研究招募了携带ARID1A突变的晚期实体瘤和淋巴瘤患者，这些患者在先前的治疗方案中出现了疾病进展。患者被分为6个疾病特异性队列：ARID1A突变体实体瘤（M1）、ARID1A突变体卵巢透明细胞癌（M2）、ARID1A突变体子宫内膜癌（M3）、淋巴瘤（M4）、胸膜或腹膜间皮瘤伴BAP1丢失（M5）、转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌（M6）。研究的主要终点是研究人员评估的客观缓解率（ORR）；次要终点包括无进展生存期（PFS）、缓解持续时间（DOR）、至症状缓解时间（TTR）、疾病控制率（DCR）、总生存期（OS）等。研究结果显示，在采用Simon两阶段设计的五个队列中（M4队列除外），M2、M3和M5共三个队列获得了进入第二阶段的资格。在M2中（n=14），4例最佳反应为部分缓解（PR），4例疾病稳定（SD），6例疾病进展（PD）。在M3中（n=8），2例最佳反应为完全缓解（CR），1例SD，2例PD，1例无法评估疗效，1例停止治疗。在M5中（n=21），3例最佳反应为PR，10例SD，6例PD，2例停止治疗。另外三个队列（不进入第二阶段研究）的数据如下：在M1中（n=10），1例获得未经确认的PR，3例SD，2例PD，4例停止治疗。在M4中（n=12），2例最佳反应为CR，1例最佳反应为PR，4例PD，5例停止治疗。在M6中（n=10），6例最佳缓解为SD，3例PD，1例停止治疗。基于上述研究，FDA授予Tulmimetostat（CPI-0209）快速通道资格，用于治疗携带ARID1A突变且在至少1种既往治疗中出现进展的、晚期复发性或转移性子宫内膜癌患者。

p_var.variant_interpret_en: The allele frequencies of this variant are 0.00006418(6/93486), 0.00001440(21/1458154), 0.00001313(2/152290) in the ExAC, gnomADe, gnomADg databases, respectively, with no record in the 1000G or iJGVD databases; the Cancer Hotspots database and the COSMIC database have no record for this variant. Based on the splice prediction tool SpliceAI, this variant may not affect splicing.

p_var.variant_interpret_cn: 该变异可能形成功能损伤或失活的蛋白。该变异在gnomADe数据库NFE人群等位基因频率为0.000003604（4/1109772），1000G、ExAC、gnomADg、iJGVD数据库无记录；ClinVar数据库报道该变异（ID=184999）的胚系突变分类为Pathogenic（可靠度为三颗星），体系突变分类为Oncogenic（可靠度为零颗星）。文献报道，在1个家系中该变异与8名患者存在5次共分离现象（PMID: 12901799）。在20例经典家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者中报道该变异（PMID: 30897307, PMID: 20924072, PMID: 10768871, PMID: 9950360, PMID: 20223039, PMID: 37577746）。
p_var.variant_interpret_en: This variant is expected to form functionally impaired or inactive proteins. The allele frequency of this variant is 0.000003604(4/1109772) in the NFE population of the gnomADe database, with no record in the 1000G, ExAC, gnomADg or iJGVD databases; the record of this variant in the ClinVar database (ID=184999) is Pathogenic in germline classification (review status: three stars) and Oncogenic in somatic classification (review status: zero star). Literature reports that this variant co-segregated with 8 patients 5 times in one family (PMID: 12901799). This variant was reported in 20 patients with classic familial adenomatous polyposis (PMID: 30897307, PMID: 20924072, PMID: 10768871, PMID: 9950360, PMID: 20223039, PMID: 37577746).

一项回顾性分析（PMID: 33230914），分析了MSS患者中APC突变状态与预后的关系。与APC突变型患者（n=255）相比，APC野生型的患者（n=86）中，右半结直肠癌占比（41.7% vs 27%）、BRAF V600E突变率（23.3% vs 0.8%）、KRAS野生型比例（65.1% vs 49.8%）均更高。WNT通路中的RNF43和CTNNB1突变的比例在APC野生型患者中比例更高（7% vs 0.4% ，4.7% vs 0.4%）。APC野生型患者的OS更差（22.6个月 vs 45.6个月，p<0.0001）。通过多元模型校正肿瘤原发位置、RAS和BRAF状态等因素，确认APC野生型可预测更差的预后（突变型 vs野生型，hazard ratio =0.62，95%致信区间为0.44-0.86，p=0.0037)。在MSKCC的公共数据库中的934例IV期患者的数据中也进行了进一步确认（突变型 vs 野生型，hazard ratio =0.63，95%致信区间为0.49-0.81，p<0.0001)。

This variant is not recorded in the 1000G, ExAC, gnomAD or iJGVD databases; the record of this variant in the ClinVar database (ID=1012190) is Likely pathogenic in germline classification (review status: one star).

evi_sum.evi_interpretation: 一项临床前研究中（PMID: 22440753），JW55对APC突变的结直肠癌细胞系表现出良好的抑制活性，并可抑制携带APC突变的小鼠模型中的肿瘤生长。
一项动物实验中（PMID: 23539443），G007-LK可抑制APC突变的结直肠癌细胞系移植瘤模型中的肿瘤生长。

一项回顾性分析（PMID: 33230914），分析了MSS患者中APC突变状态与预后的关系。与APC突变型患者（n=255）相比，APC野生型的患者（n=86）中，右半结直肠癌占比（41.7% vs 27%）、BRAF V600E突变率（23.3% vs 0.8%）、KRAS野生型比例（65.1% vs 49.8%）均更高。WNT通路中的RNF43和CTNNB1突变的比例在APC野生型患者中比例更高（7% vs 0.4% ，4.7% vs 0.4%）。APC野生型患者的OS更差（22.6个月 vs 45.6个月，p<0.0001）。通过多元模型校正肿瘤原发位置、RAS和BRAF状态等因素，确认APC野生型可预测更差的预后（突变型 vs野生型，hazard ratio =0.62，95%致信区间为0.44-0.86，p=0.0037)。在MSKCC的公共数据库中的934例IV期患者的数据中也进行了进一步确认（突变型 vs 野生型，hazard ratio =0.63，95%致信区间为0.49-0.81，p<0.0001)。

Based on the ensemble prediction tool REVEL, this variant is considered intermediate, based on the splice prediction tool SpliceAI, this variant may not affect splicing.

p_var.variant_interpret_cn: 该变异在gnomADe数据库等位基因频率为0.000004105（6/1461760），gnomADg数据库非始祖效应人群中无记录；ClinVar数据库报道该变异（ID=43594）的胚系突变分类为Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic（可靠度为两颗星），体系突变分类为Oncogenic（可靠度为一颗星）。变异位于TP53基因的热点区域，Cancer Hotspots数据库记录609次TP53蛋白第273位氨基酸上的变异，其中突变型R273C记录283次；体外蛋白功能研究结果显示，该变异影响蛋白功能（PMID: 12826609, PMID: 29979965, PMID: 30224644）。基于预测工具BayesDel及aGVGD认为该变异为disease-causing，剪接预测软件SpliceAI认为该变异不影响剪接。文献在3位符合Chompret标准的先证者中报道该变异（PMID: 10864200, PMID: 11315715, PMID: 19556618）。
p_var.variant_interpret_en: The allele frequency of this variant is 0.000004105(6/1461760) in the gnomADe database, with no record among non-founder effect populations of the gnomADg database; the record of this variant in the ClinVar database (ID=43594) is Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic in germline classification (review status: two stars) and Oncogenic in somatic classification (review status: one star). This variant is located in hotspot region of the p53 protein, the Cancer Hotspots database records 609 times of amino acid change at the TP53 protein position 273, of which the mutant R273C is recorded 283 times; the in vitro protein functional studies demonstrate that this variant affects protein function (PMID: 12826609, PMID: 29979965, PMID: 30224644). . Based on the prediction tools REVEL and aGVGD, this variant is considered disease-causing, based on the splice prediction tool SpliceAI, this variant may not affect splicing.Literature reports that this variation was reported in three probands that met the Chompret criteria (PMID: 10864200, PMID: 11315715, PMID: 19556618).

p_var.variant_desc_en: This variant is a missense mutation, which changes the 273rd amino acid of the gene-encoded protein from Arginine to Cysteine.

evi_sum.evi_interpretation: 一项多中心II期临床试验（NCT01357161, PMID: 32611648），试验分为2个部分，第一部分为开放标签的安全性试验，第二部分为随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的临床试验；总共入组121位TP53突变的铂敏感的卵巢癌、输卵管癌或原发性腹膜癌患者，分别使用Adavosertib(AZD1775)+卡铂+紫杉醇或安慰剂+卡铂+紫杉醇治疗。主要研究终点为ePFS（RECIST v1.1加强版评估的PFS）和安全性。研究结果：PFS对比中，Adavosertib+卡铂+紫杉醇 vs 安慰剂+卡铂+紫杉醇为7.9个月 vs 7.3个月（HR 0.63[95% CI 0.38-1.06];two-side P=0.080），满足预设的显著性阈值（P＜0.2）。

一项II期临床试验（NCT03588078, PMID: 33600210），入组52例携带TP53突变的患者，包括34例骨髓异常增长综合征患者（MDS）、18例急性髓系白血病患者（AML，包括7名骨髓母细胞超过30%的患者），使用APR-246（Eprenetapopt）联合阿扎胞苷进行治疗；主要终点为缓解率，次要终点为安全性、总生存期等参数。研究结果显示，MDS患者的总体缓解率为62%，包括47%的完全缓解率，中位缓解持续时间为10.4个月；AML患者的总体缓解率为33%，包括17%的完全缓解率（在骨髓母细胞小于和大于30%的急性髓系白血病中，总缓解率分别为27%、0%）。中位随访时间为9.7个月，MDS的中位OS为12.1个月，骨髓母细胞小于和大于30%的AML的中位OS分别为13.9和3.0个月。研究结论为：在极高危TP53m MDS和AML患者群体中，APR-246（Eprenetapopt）联合阿扎胞苷是安全的，并显示出比单独使用阿扎胞苷更高的缓解率，以及更长的总生存期。

一项II期、开放标签、非随机研究（NCT01164995, PMID: 37236033），入组32名中位年龄为63岁（39–77岁）的TP53突变PROC（抗铂性卵巢癌）患者，使用卡铂AUC 5 mg/ml·min静脉注射和阿达沃司替布（Adavosertib）225 mg BID口服，为期2.5天，周期21天；主要目的是确定卡铂和阿达沃司替布的疗效和安全性。次要目标包括无进展生存期（PFS）、循环肿瘤细胞（CTC）变化等。研究结果显示，在29名可疗效评估的患者中，12名患者部分缓解（PR），客观ORR为41%（95% CI:23%-61%），中位PFS为5.6个月（95% CI:3.8-10.3）。研究认为：阿达沃司替布225 mg BID 2.5天和卡铂AUC 5联合使用是安全的，并在PROC患者中显示出抗肿瘤疗效。

一项I期、开放标签、非随机三组剂量递增的临床试验中（NCT00648648，PMID: 27601554），入组202名晚期实体瘤患者，组1（n=9）先接受单剂量Adavosertib/AZD1775（观察14天，8人加入组2A），组2接受单剂量Adavosertib（组2A，n=43）或每日两次五倍剂量/每日一次双倍剂量（组2B，n=158）联合一种化疗（吉西他滨、顺铂或卡铂）。研究结果显示，在176名可评估疗效的患者中，94名（53%）患者病情稳定，17名（10%）患者达到部分缓解；TP53突变患者（n=19）中4名达到部分缓解（PR），应答率为21%，而TP53野生型患者（n=33）为12%。研究结论为，Adavosertib单剂联合化疗安全、耐受性好；TP53突变患者的应答率更高一些，但仍需扩大样本量进一步评估。

一项I期临床试验（NCT01339871, PMID: 25669829），旨在探究培唑帕尼（Pazopanib）联合伏立诺他（Vorinostat）在晚期实体瘤患者中的最高耐受剂量和安全性。共纳入78例患者（肉瘤：n=23，结直肠癌：n=14，黑色素瘤：n=7，卵巢癌：n=5，肾细胞癌：n=4；肝癌：n=3，非小细胞肺癌：n=3，其他：n=19），接受11个剂量水平的联合治疗，结果表明：15例（19%）患者具有临床获益（PR：n=4，SD≥6个月：n=11），78例患者的中位PFS和中位OS分别为2.2个月、8.9个月；使用Cox回归模型确定临床获益的多变量分析中显示TP53突变状态与临床获益有关，36例患者接受了TP53突变检测，与TP53野生型的患者（n=25）相比，TP53突变型患者（n=11）的临床获益率更高（45% vs 16%）、中位PFS更长（3.5个月 vs 2.0个月）、中位OS更长（12.7个月 vs 7.4个月），从联合治疗中获益的TP53突变型患者为：携带TP53 R213*、G245S的结直肠癌患者，携带TP53 R175H、DBDdel、H193R的肉瘤患者。所有患者中未出现与治疗相关的死亡事件，推荐的II期剂量为培唑帕尼（600 mg/天）联合伏立诺他（300 mg/天）。

一项大型多臂、伞式临床研究（VIKTORY, NCT02299648, PMID: 31315834），入组143例胃癌患者，评估不同治疗方案对于不同分子标记胃癌的疗效。其中，第2臂（Arm 2）为25例TP53突变的胃癌患者，接受Adavosertib联合紫杉醇治疗。主要研究终点为客观缓解率（ORR）。研究结果提示：ORR为24%，6例患者获得了部分缓解（PR），这其中有3例患者的缓解时间超过6个月；臂内比较显示，TP53 R273C、R175H、R342X、Y220C突变的胃癌患者肿瘤负荷下降最大。结论：Adavosertib联合紫杉醇对于TP53 R273C、R175H、R342X、Y220C突变的胃癌患者有较好的抗肿瘤活性。

p_var.variant_desc_cn: 微卫星（Microsatellite）又称简单重复序列（SSR），是指遍布于人类基因组中的短串联重复序列，一般由1-6个核苷酸组成。DNA复制时，肿瘤细胞内的微卫星由于重复单位的插入或缺失而造成的微卫星长度的变化，称为微卫星不稳定性（Microsatellite Instability, MSI）。大量研究表明，MSI是由错配修复（mismatch repair，MMR）基因突变或功能缺陷引起的（PMID: 25701956）。MSI在多种癌种中被发现，包括子宫内膜癌、结直肠癌和胃腺癌等。据报道，10%-15%的散发性结直肠癌患者存在MSI（PMID: 15528785），NCCN指南明确推荐所有结直肠癌患者均需考虑做MSI或MMR检测。临床上也已将MSI作为结直肠癌及其他实体瘤预后和制定辅助治疗方案的重要分子标志物。
p_var.variant_desc_en: Microsatellite, also known as simple repeat sequence (SSR), refers to the short tandem repeat sequences throughout the human genome, generally composed of 1-6 nucleotides. During DNA replication, Microsatellite Instability (MSI) is defined as the change in microsatellite length caused by the insertion or deletion of repeat units in tumor cells. Numerous studies have shown that MSI is caused by mismatch repair (MMR) gene mutations or functional defects (PMID: 25701956). MSI has been found in a variety of cancers, including endometrial cancer, colorectal cancer, and gastric adenocarcinoma. MSI has been reported in 10%-15% of sporadic colorectal cancer patients (PMID: 15528785), and the NCCN guidelines clearly recommend that all patients with colorectal cancer should be considered for MSI or MMR testing. MSI has also been regarded as an important molecular marker for the prognosis and adjuvant treatment of colorectal cancer and other solid tumors.

evi_sum.evi_interpretation: CSCO结直肠癌指南（2022）中，对RAS和BRAF均野生型的初始不可切除转移性结肠癌患者，如适合强烈治疗，推荐的治疗方案中包括西妥昔单抗联合不同的化疗（FOLFOX、FOLFIRI等）、贝伐珠单抗联合不同的化疗（FOLFOX、CAPEOX、FOLFIRI、FOLFOXIRI等），其中针对原发灶位于左侧结直肠和右侧结直肠的，上述治疗方案的推荐级别不同。如不适合强烈治疗且MSS或MSI-L/pMMR，推荐的治疗方案包括氟尿嘧啶类单药±贝伐珠单抗、西妥昔单抗单药（左半结直肠）、减量的两药化疗±西妥昔单抗/贝伐珠单抗等。根据一线接受的治疗方案的不同，二线治疗推荐的治疗方案中包括选择不同的化疗方案±西妥昔单抗/贝伐珠单抗。对MSS或MSI-L/pMMR患者，三线治疗推荐的治疗方案中还包括瑞戈非尼、呋喹替尼等。对于原发灶可切除（≤中度复发风险）、转移瘤不可切除的同时性转移性直肠癌的治疗原则同上所述。

NCCN结直肠癌指南中认为，所有转移性结直肠癌患者均应进行RAS基因（KRAS和NRAS）及BRAF基因突变检测；并指出，KRAS、NRAS基因突变（2/3/4号外显子中）的结直肠癌患者不能用西妥昔单抗或帕尼单抗进行治疗；而BRAF V600E突变的患者除非同时使用BRAF抑制剂，否则极有可能对西妥昔单抗和帕尼单抗无反应。对于KRAS/NRAS/BRAF基因突变为阴性的直肠癌、左半结肠癌患者，可根据疾病分期和转移状态，使用西妥昔单抗/帕尼单抗联合不同的化疗药物进行治疗。

CSCO结直肠癌指南（2022）中，对RAS和BRAF均野生型的初始不可切除转移性结肠癌患者，如适合强烈治疗，推荐的治疗方案中包括西妥昔单抗联合不同的化疗（FOLFOX、FOLFIRI等）、贝伐珠单抗联合不同的化疗（FOLFOX、CAPEOX、FOLFIRI、FOLFOXIRI等），其中针对原发灶位于左侧结直肠和右侧结直肠的，上述治疗方案的推荐级别不同。如不适合强烈治疗且MSS或MSI-L/pMMR，推荐的治疗方案包括氟尿嘧啶类单药±贝伐珠单抗、西妥昔单抗单药（左半结直肠）、减量的两药化疗±西妥昔单抗/贝伐珠单抗等。根据一线接受的治疗方案的不同，二线治疗推荐的治疗方案中包括选择不同的化疗方案±西妥昔单抗/贝伐珠单抗。对MSS或MSI-L/pMMR患者，三线治疗推荐的治疗方案中还包括瑞戈非尼、呋喹替尼等。对于原发灶可切除（≤中度复发风险）、转移瘤不可切除的同时性转移性直肠癌的治疗原则同上所述。

evi_sum.evi_adaptation_disease_cn: NMPA批准西妥昔单抗β与FOLFIRI方案联合用于一线治疗RAS/BRAF基因野生型的转移性结直肠癌。
evi_sum.evi_interpretation: 一项开放、随机对照、多中心、前瞻性Ⅲ期临床研究（CTR20170701），分析了505例RAS/BRAF基因野生型、转移性结直肠癌受试者。临床数据显示，西妥昔单抗β联合FOLFIRI化疗方案，与单用FOLFIRI化疗相比显著延长患者的无进展生存期（PFS, 13.133个月 vs. 9.567个月, P=0.004），提升客观缓解率（ORR，69.1% vs. 42.3%, P<0.001)，且延长了总生存期（OS，2.322年 vs. 1.900年, P=0.024）。基于上述研究，NMPA批准西妥昔单抗β与FOLFIRI方案联合用于一线治疗RAS/BRAF基因野生型的转移性结直肠癌。

CSCO结直肠癌指南（2022）中，对RAS和BRAF均野生型的初始不可切除转移性结肠癌患者，如适合强烈治疗，推荐的治疗方案中包括西妥昔单抗联合不同的化疗（FOLFOX、FOLFIRI等）、贝伐珠单抗联合不同的化疗（FOLFOX、CAPEOX、FOLFIRI、FOLFOXIRI等），其中针对原发灶位于左侧结直肠和右侧结直肠的，上述治疗方案的推荐级别不同。如不适合强烈治疗且MSS或MSI-L/pMMR，推荐的治疗方案包括氟尿嘧啶类单药±贝伐珠单抗、西妥昔单抗单药（左半结直肠）、减量的两药化疗±西妥昔单抗/贝伐珠单抗等。根据一线接受的治疗方案的不同，二线治疗推荐的治疗方案中包括选择不同的化疗方案±西妥昔单抗/贝伐珠单抗。对MSS或MSI-L/pMMR患者，三线治疗推荐的治疗方案中还包括瑞戈非尼、呋喹替尼等。对于原发灶可切除（≤中度复发风险）、转移瘤不可切除的同时性转移性直肠癌的治疗原则同上所述。

evi_sum.evi_interpretation: 一项回顾性研究中（PMID: 32111729），分析了3403位病人的数据，这些患者的肿瘤组织均有二代测序数据。在9个ARID1A发生率大于5%的癌种中，与ARID1A野生型的患者相比，ARID1A突变的患者中具有MSI-H和TMB-H的比例显著更高（20% vs 0.9%, p<0.001;26% vs 8.4%, p<0.001）。在接受检查点阻断免疫疗法后，ARID1A突变的患者（n=46）的中位PFS显著高于ARID1A野生型的患者（n=329）（11个月 vs 4个月，p=0.006），且该结果独立于MSI或TMB；另外，ARID1A突变患者的中位OS也显著高于野生型患者（31个月 vs 20个月），但是没有统计学差异。
